jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for a Supervisor of Sales Process Administration to lead a small team of administrators responsible for executing high-volume, time-sensitive sales operations. This entry-level leadership role requires strong coordination, people management fundamentals, and a passion for team enablement and process optimization.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Mexico. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You’re ready to take the next step into people leadership.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You enjoy solving day-to-day issues and coaching others.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You’re committed to high standards and consistency in operational processes.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.
  • You want to grow your leadership skills in a high-performance environment.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage a team of 5–10 sales process administrators.
  • Monitor daily workload, support ticket volume, and service levels.
  • Support team development and knowledge-sharing across process areas.
  • Partner with Sales Operations and cross-functional teams to resolve blockers.
  • Identify training needs and coordinate onboarding of new team members.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in Sales Operations or Administrative Support.
  • 1+ years in a mentoring, team lead, or project coordination capacity.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish.
  • Ability to analyze trends and report on team performance.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams or in a remote setting.
  • Experience with NetSuite.
  • Experience with Zendesk.
  • Experience with SalesForce.
  • Project management experience.
  • Familiarity with coaching frameworks or leadership development programs.
  • Experience supporting enterprise accounts or managing escalations.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Job Title: Technical Advisor III, Development Finance for Water and EnvironmentReports to: STA IF Strategic PartnershipsDepartment: PIQA, Innovative FinanceSalary Grade: 11

Job Summary

The Technical Advisor for Development Finance in Water and Environment (TA-WE) contributes to the development and implementation of innovative finance strategies and solutions that mobilize capital and strengthen the sustainability of programming focused on water security, watershed restoration, nature-based solutions, and climate resilience. As part of the Innovative Finance Unit (IF), the TA-WE provides technical leadership and advisory support tocountry, regional, and global teams, working closely with the CRS Global Water Security unit and the Livelihoods, Markets, Agriculture and Climate unit (LMAC) to advance the delivery of high-quality, innovative programming. And through technical expertise, partnership engagement, and strategic influence, the TA-WE contributes and supports the integration of development finance approaches into program design, business development, and implementation, helping scale social and environmental impact through financially sustainable models.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

Technical

  • Contribute to the design and implementation of innovative finance strategies, standards, tools, and best practices for water security, watershed restoration, climate resilience, and nature-based solutions, ensuring alignment with CRS programming principles and cross-sectoral approaches.
  • Provide technical solutions and advisory support to country, regional, and global teams on development finance approaches, partnership models, financial mechanisms, and sustainable financing strategies that strengthen program quality and impact.
  • Collaborate with the Global Water Security, Livelihoods, Markets, Agriculture and Climate (LMAC), and Innovative Finance teams to integrate development finance approaches into program design, implementation, and adaptive management processes.
  • Serve as a technical resource and focal point for development finance approaches within water and environmental programming, providing specialized expertise and guidance to country, regional, and global teams.

Program Support

  • Contribute to agency, regional, and country program efforts to position CRS for strategic funding opportunities in innovative finance for water and environmental programming, providing technical guidance for complex proposals, concept development, and project design.
  • Support identification and development of innovative financing opportunities involving development finance institutions, investors, donors, private-sector actors, and other partners that advance CRS program objectives.
  • Provide technical guidance to country programs and strategic initiatives applying innovative finance approaches to water security, ecosystem restoration, climate adaptation, regenerative agriculture, and related environmental outcomes.
  • Support execution of the Somos Rio Lempa Program in El Salvador and directly support program efforts to catalyze co-investments for program activities related to access to water supply, water treatment plans, wastewater management, modernizing irrigation, and promoting regenerative agriculture and nature-based solutions.

Catalytic Funding and Business Development

jobs.description:
Join our team as an Inpatient Coder! Role responsibilities include assessing documentation for each service rendered in the hospital’s place of service, in order to accurately code principal diagnoses (i.e. preponderance of care sequence), secondary conditions, procedures, and social determinant codes using American Hospital Association guidelines, Current Procedural Terminology guidelines, payer specific rules for commercial and/or Medicaid insurance, and drug administration for specified service lines impacting Florida’s enhanced ambulatory grouping. This includes excellent working knowledge of revenue charge capture and the impact to hospital billing (i.e. soft vs. hard coded charges),working knowledge of revenue codes, relevant grouper function and financial impact; assessment and entry of surgical charges (i.e. supplies, implants), and pharmacy charges (i.e. contrast, patient supplied, etc).

This position is remote. Applicants must reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Colorado, Delaware, the District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia.

Responsibilities:

  1. Ability to comprehend medical record documentation to accurately assign codes for both concurrent and discharged accounts across multiple specialties.
  2. Meets minimum requirements for production and quality monthly.
  3. Requires a working knowledge of code sequencing for grouper-related payers with attention to detail to avoid rework and waste with charge capture assessment component.
  4. Requires understanding and application of M.E.A.T. criteria (i.e., monitoring, evaluation, assessment, treatment) using ICD 10 CM transaction data set to capture diagnoses.
  5. Analyzes high-risk encounters for accurate and/or missing charges gaps prior to encounter completion (i.e., missing charges from anesthesia, surgery) when manual charge capture occurs.
  6. Understand complexity of billing requirements and incorporates payer specific trends into day-to-day reviews to reduce “take backs” associated with un-clear, or un-substantiated care rendered. (i.e., varying modifier assignment for EAPG vs. Non-EAPG payer specificity)
  7. Requires excellent coding knowledge of ICD 10 CM, CPT 4, and modifier application, with expectations to maintain certification (i.e., CCS, CPC, RHIT, or RHIA) and apply ICD 10 CM Coding Guidelines specific to both inpatient and outpatient encounters.
  8. Facilitate modifications to clinical documentation through query interaction to ensure that the information captured supports the level of service rendered, with attention towards chronic conditions, hierarchical condition categories (HCC), and risk adjustment factors (RAF).
  9. Demonstrates an excellent working knowledge of hospital information systems to retrieve data specific information (i.e., order diagnosis, patient type) within a complicated filing schema including non-hospital data (i.e., Media Tab, Office Visits etc)

Qualifications:

  1. Minimum education of an Associate's degree required
  2. Medical Terminology, Anatomy and Physiology required
  3. One of the following certifications required: CPC, CCS, RHIT, RHIA, COC (please include on resume)

jobs.description:
CRS is recruiting in anticipation of an award – recruitment for all candidates is contingent upon successful award of the project.

Background

CRS is seeking candidates for an anticipated five-year multi-country project which will be funded by the Department of State. The overall objective of the project is to deliver cost-effective, high-quality integrated HIV, tuberculosis, maternal and child health, malaria and nutrition health services through government and a strengthened community and facility-based health worker networks using faith and community-based platforms, with a clear and time-bound plan to sustainably transition program activities to national and sub-national government and stakeholders.

Job Summary

This position will contribute to the project’s overall objective of delivering lifesaving integrated health services through community and facility-based health worker networks using faith and community-based platforms and transition project activities to national and sub-national government and stakeholders.

The Global Chief of Party will provide leadership and overall management of the project to serve the poor and vulnerable. The Chief of Party’s leadership, management and technical knowledge will ensure the delivery of high-quality programming and advance the position of CRS as a leading agency in the health sector. The COP I will supervise the HQ team, coordinate with country program teams collaborate with GAPS and related CRS department staff, and represent CRS with partners and stakeholders, and the donor. As a senior leader the COP I will proactively manage security and mitigate security risks.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all aspects of the development, implementation, management and evaluation of the CRS project, including sharing how the project contributes to the thought leadership of the health and development sectors. Serve as the primary point of contact the donor as well as public, private and non-government stakeholders.
  • Ensure the project is designed and implemented to meet donor expectations in terms of timely and quality results and budget, including strategies for phase out and sustainability. Ensure coordination between program and operations leads. Ensure the CRS program quality standards are adhered to per MEAL policy and procedures.
  • Coordinate Country Program Project leads, ensuring effective contribution to global objectives, sharing lessons learned across CPs, and enabling appropriate global support.
  • Coordinate relationships with consortium partner organizations, including organization of review/planning workshops. Contribute to coordination of the roles and activities of staff from other consortium member organizations in implementation in line with CRS partnership principles.
  • Effectively manage senior programming and operations talent across the project. Manage team dynamics and staff well-being. Provide coaching and mentoring. Strategically tailor individual development plans and complete performance assessments for direct reports. Oversee the development of staffing plans and the recruitment process of senior staff.
  • Manage and mitigate risk through monitoring national and regional issues that may impact staff and programming. Ensure all staff understand and adhere to CRS staff safety and security policies and plans, and ensure the updating of such plans.
  • Promote, uphold and model a commitment to the efficient use of agency and donor resources. Ensure compliance with donor grants, including financial tracking and oversight of partner budgets, finance, administration and reporting..
  • Oversee the development of communication strategies and materials, complying with donor and CRS’ branding and marketing requirements and procedures.
  • Create and maintain proper conditions for learning. Establish a safe environment for sharing of ideas, solutions, and difficulties and the capacity to detect, analyze and respond quickly to deficiencies. Identify performance gaps and training opportunities for CRS and partner staff and ensure the design and delivery of high-quality training and technical assistance.

We are currently seeking a Tools Engineer (Infrastructure Automation & Cloud Platforms) - US REMOTE to join our team in Plano, Texas (US-TX), United States (US).

Tools Engineer (Infrastructure Automation & Cloud Platforms)

Experience Level:

  • 3–8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, automation, DevOps, or platform engineering

Technologies:

  • Terraform

  • Git, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions

Role Summary

The Tools Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining automation solutions that enable scalable, repeatable, and secure cloud infrastructure deployments. This role focuses on Infrastructure-as-Code, cloud platform automation, CI/CD integration, and operational tooling that supports cloud migration, provisioning, and ongoing platform operations.

The ideal candidate combines strong Terraform expertise with cloud platform knowledge, automation skills, and an operational mindset to improve deployment efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance service reliability across multi-cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain reusable Terraform modules and Infrastructure-as-Code solutions supporting AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI environments.

  • Develop and maintain standardized infrastructure templates, modules, and deployment patterns to promote consistency and scalability.
  • Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning and configuration using:
    • Terraform
    • AWS CloudFormation
    • Azure ARM/Bicep templates
    • GCP Deployment Manager
    • OCI Resource Manager
  • Support deployment of compute, storage, networking, identity, and security services across cloud platforms.
  • Integrate automation solutions with enterprise landing zone and governance standards.
  • Develop automation scripts and tooling using:
    • Python
    • Bash
    • PowerShell
  • Leverage APIs and automation frameworks to:
    • Eliminate manual processes
    • Streamline environment provisioning
    • Support migration and deployment activities
    • Improve operational efficiency
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using:
    • Azure DevOps
    • GitHub Actions
    • Git-based source control workflows
  • Support automated infrastructure deployment, testing, validation, and promotion across development, test, staging, and production environments.
  • Implement infrastructure version control and release management best practices.
  • Collaborate with Cloud Engineers, Platform Teams, Security Teams, and Application Teams to develop automated deployment and operational solutions.
  • Build and maintain configuration management, monitoring, and operational automation capabilities.
  • Support implementation of security controls including:
    • IAM roles and policies
    • Least-privilege access models
    • Secrets management
    • Infrastructure compliance validation
  • Develop operational documentation, deployment guides, architecture diagrams, and runbooks.
  • Continuously evaluate opportunities to improve automation, reduce deployment complexity, and increase platform reliability.

Troubleshooting & Operational Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure deployment issues across cloud platforms and environments.
  • Debug Terraform code, module dependencies, configuration errors, and state management issues.
  • Analyze and resolve CI/CD pipeline failures and deployment exceptions.
  • Support incident response and operational remediation activities when infrastructure automation impacts service delivery.
  • Work effectively within customer environments where access constraints, incomplete requirements, or changing priorities may require creative problem-solving and adaptability.
  • Identify root causes of recurring deployment and provisioning issues and implement permanent corrective actions.
  • Support environment validations, smoke testing, and post-deployment verification activities.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure fundamentals, including:
    • Networking
    • Identity and Access Management (IAM)
    • Compute services
    • Storage services
    • Security controls
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, and/or OCI cloud platforms.
  • Experience developing automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages.
  • Experience integrating infrastructure deployments with CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills within complex cloud environments.
  • Experience using Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively within dynamic, rapidly changing environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Terraform Associate or equivalent Infrastructure-as-Code certification.
  • AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Oracle Cloud certifications.
  • Experience supporting large-scale cloud migrations and modernization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, container platforms, and platform engineering concepts.
  • Experience implementing security, compliance, and governance controls within cloud environments.
  • Experience supporting multi-cloud enterprise environments and shared services platforms.

Support Model

We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. jobs.title: Wyoming Rural Case Management, Social Work and Care Coordination Opportunities
jobs.excerpt: Wyoming Rural Healthcare Case Management, Social Work and Care Coordination OpportunitiesRural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Wyoming to identify experienced leaders and professionals in case management, social work, utilization review, discharge planning, and care coordination.
jobs.description:
Wyoming Rural Healthcare Case Management, Social Work and Care Coordination Opportunities

Rural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Wyoming to identify experienced leaders and professionals in case management, social work, utilization review, discharge planning, and care coordination.

We are currently connecting with professionals who may be interested in active and upcoming case management, social work, utilization management, discharge planning, and care coordination opportunities across Wyoming.

These opportunities may include positions within Critical Access Hospitals, community hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, public hospital districts, long-term care organizations, and integrated rural healthcare systems.

Explore Rural Healthcare Opportunities at RSSJobs.org

This application may connect you with the specific opportunity you were viewing, as well as other current or upcoming rural healthcare positions throughout Wyoming that align with your experience and goals.

Visit to explore additional rural healthcare opportunities and communities.

This Is More Than a Care Coordination Role

In rural healthcare, helping a patient safely move through the healthcare system often requires creativity, persistence, and strong community relationships.

Case management, social work, and care coordination professionals help connect patients and families with the clinical care, resources, education, and support they need. They may address barriers involving transportation, housing, insurance, behavioral health, long-term care, family support, or access to specialty services far from home.

The strongest professionals understand that a discharge plan is more than paperwork. It is a bridge between the hospital, the patient's home, local providers, community resources, and the next stage of care.

Opportunities May Include

This application may connect you with current or upcoming roles such as:

  • Director or Manager of Case Management
  • Case Management Supervisor
  • Hospital Case Manager
  • Social Work Director or Manager
  • Medical Social Worker
  • Care Coordination Director or Manager
  • Care Coordinator
  • Utilization Review or Utilization Management Director
  • Utilization Review Nurse
  • Discharge Planning Manager
  • Discharge Planner
  • Transitions of Care Manager
  • Population Health Manager
  • Community Health Program Manager
  • Complex Care Manager
  • Patient Navigation Leadership
  • Senior case management, social work, or care coordination roles

What You May Lead or Support

Responsibilities will vary by organization and position and may include:

  • Coordinating safe and appropriate patient transitions
  • Developing discharge and follow-up care plans
  • Assessing clinical, social, financial, and community needs
  • Connecting patients and families with local and regional resources
  • Collaborating with physicians, nurses, therapists, behavioral health professionals, and community partners
  • Supporting utilization review, medical necessity, and level-of-care processes
  • Communicating with payers and supporting authorization or denial-management processes
  • Reducing avoidable readmissions and delays in care
  • Supporting patients with complex medical or social needs
  • Coordinating referrals to home health, skilled nursing, rehabilitation, hospice, behavioral health, or specialty care
  • Helping patients navigate insurance, transportation, housing, medication, and other barriers
  • Developing policies, procedures, workflows, and documentation standards
  • Monitoring quality, outcomes, length of stay, and departmental performance
  • Leading, mentoring, and supporting case management or social work teams
  • Building stronger connections between the healthcare organization and the community

What You Will Bring

Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

  • Experience in case management, medical social work, utilization review, discharge planning, care coordination, or population health
  • Previous leadership experience for director, manager, or supervisory opportunities
  • Knowledge of healthcare delivery, payer requirements, medical necessity, and patient transitions
  • Experience working with patients and families facing complex clinical or social needs
  • Strong communication, assessment, advocacy, and problem-solving skills
  • The ability to collaborate across clinical, operational, and community teams
  • Experience with rural hospitals, Critical Access Hospitals, FQHCs, public hospital districts, long-term care, or community healthcare organizations
  • Relevant education, licensure, or certification based on the position
  • A compassionate, resourceful, and relationship-focused approach

Some opportunities may require or prefer credentials such as RN, LMSW, LCSW, ACM, CCM, or another case management, nursing, or social work credential. Requirements will depend on the specific position.

Why Rural Wyoming?

Wyoming's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, high plains, ranchlands, rivers, open roads, and wide-open spaces. Long distances, limited transportation, workforce shortages, and fewer local services can make care transitions especially challenging.

Working in case management, social work, or care coordination in a rural setting offers the opportunity to help patients overcome real barriers, strengthen community connections, and make care feel more coordinated and humane.

Join the RSS Rural Talent Network

By applying through this page, you are joining the confidential Rural Staffing Services talent network. You may be considered for current or upcoming case management, social work, utilization review, discharge planning, and care coordination opportunities that align with your experience, goals, preferred location, and availability.

Please submit your resume and let us know:

  • Which Wyoming communities or regions you would consider
  • Whether you are open to relocation
  • Whether you are interested in permanent, interim, remote, or multiple types of opportunities
  • Which position or community you were viewing on RSSJobs.org

Our team personally reviews each application. When we identify an opportunity that may be a strong match, we will contact you directly to share more about the organization, community, position, and next steps.

Your information will be handled professionally and confidentially.

Discover More Rural Healthcare Opportunities

Visit to explore additional rural healthcare positions, leadership opportunities, and communities throughout Wyoming.

Work Where It Matters.

Built for Rural.

The Salesforce Business Analyst and Configuration Specialist is a key liaison between business stakeholders and the technical team, responsible for understanding business needs, translating them into Salesforce solutions, and ensuring alignment between technology and business objectives. jobs.excerpt: Organization SummaryThe vision of Edify is to see Flourishing, Godly Nations, and we seek to accomplish this by improving and expanding sustainable Christ-centered education globally.
jobs.description:
Organization Summary

The vision of Edify is to see Flourishing, Godly Nations, and we seek to accomplish this by improving and expanding sustainable Christ-centered education globally. Edify is a non-profit organization registered in the U.S. since 2009 and now has operations in 16 countries, including Bolivia, Burkina Faso, the Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Ethiopia, Ghana, Guatemala, Kenya, Liberia, Nigeria, Panama, Peru, Rwanda, Sierra Leone, and Uganda. Edify serves low-fee independent Christ-centered schools through three primary avenues: loans, training, and education technology.

Learn more at

Location: Remote

Start Date: October 1, 2026

Reports To: VP for Christ-Centered Education
Salary Range: Commensurate with experience and education and competitive with other nonprofits

Position Summary:

Edify promotes holistic and high-quality Christ-centered education in partnership with low-fee independent Christ-centered schools. The Global Curriculum and Assessment Lead is a full-time position that will thrive in a challenging, innovative, and empowering mission-focused work environment. This role is responsible for maintaining high-quality of Edify’s training curricula and delivery of assessments across Edify’s teacher and facilitator training programmes, supporting multiple countries, cohorts, and academic terms simultaneously.

The role will oversee the quality development and delivery of Edify training content/curriculum and coordinate the end-to-end assessment cycle, including assessment operations and programme delivery, TalentLMS management, marking and moderation, AI-assisted grading workflows, and quality assurance.

This role will also work closely with the Online Learning Managers in Latin America, East Africa, and West Africa, as well as Edify consultants supporting the marking of assessments for key Edify trainings. Moreover, the Global Curriculum and Assessment Lead will support the work of the Christ-Centered Education (CCE) Regional Leads to ensure consistent quality training development and delivery across all CCE trainings.

Work Environment:

This position will be full-time based in the location of employee’s choice, reporting to the VP for Christ-Centered Education. The atmosphere of Edify is one where you can expect to perform widely varied tasks related to the role.

Travel Expectation:

The position requires the ability to travel globally as needed, with occasional travel being possible in order to support Edify’s ongoing training work . In addition to role-based travel, Edify holds an annual all-staff meeting, alternating in a US-based or international location each year. Travel would be required to attend this meeting.

Primary Responsibilities:

1. Assessment Programs Leadership

  • Lead the end-to-end assessment process for teacher and facilitator programs (e.g., EoMs and Practical Implementation for the International Diploma in Education) across multiple countries, cohorts, and academic terms.
  • Plan and coordinate concurrent assessment cycles, ensuring assessments are delivered consistently and on time.
  • Lead the ongoing development of Edify's assessment strategy and training
  • Support regional managers as they secure partnerships with local universities for the accreditation of the iDE (specifically the adaptation of the assessments and content required for these accreditations).
  • Build strong working relationships across in-country and technical teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment on assessment priorities, timelines, and challenges.
  • Provide regular updates to senior Edify staff on progress, risks, and emerging priorities.

2. Operational Leadership

2.1. Systems and LMS Administration

  • Set up and maintain assessment modules and learner records in TalentLMS, Salesforce and on the Drive.
  • Upload and verify assessment results in TalentLMS and Salesforce.
  • Develop systems, processes, and local capability to enable routine LMS administration to be delegated to a dedicated operational support as the programme scales.
  • Develop quality control and consistency standards across multiple online training programs so that Edify online courses follow an equally high standard across regions.

2.2 Data Quality and Assessment Operations

  • Export, validate, and maintain assessment data, ensuring learner and submission records are complete and accurate before marking begins.
  • Lead the identification and resolution of data quality issues and operational bottlenecks.
  • Establish data quality standards and quality assurance processes that enable routine data management to be undertaken by dedicated operational support while maintaining central oversight.

2.3 Governance, Risk, and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead the identification and resolution of operational risks in collaboration with programme, technical, and country teams.
  • Maintain clear documentation, processes, and reporting to support consistent assessment delivery at scale.
  • Develop frameworks, policies, and standard operating procedures that support consistent assessment and curriculum delivery and enable greater operational ownership by local teams as the programme grows

3. Assessment Quality and AI Grading Innovation

  • Lead the development and refinement of assessment rubrics and assessment design.
  • Determine the most appropriate marking approach for each assessment, balancing AI-assisted and human marking.
  • Lead AI grading implementation, testing, moderation, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop moderation frameworks and quality assurance processes and guidance for markers.
  • Analyse assessment outcomes to identify misconceptions and improve assessments.
  • Lead the ongoing development of EoMs, "Are You Ready?" assessments, and the assessment question bank for the International Diploma of Education.

4. Marking, Moderation and Capacity Building

  • Lead teams of markers across countries and cohorts working alongside AI grading systems.
  • Recruit, train, onboard, and support new markers.
  • Coordinate marking workloads and moderation activities.
  • Conduct pre- and post-marking moderation.
  • Develop training materials and guidance for marking, including online asynchronous training on the LMS.
  • Support Online Training Managers in three regions.

5. Continuous Improvement and Learning Analytics

  • Analyse assessment and learner data across cohorts and countries to identify trends and misconceptions.
  • Use assessment findings to improve learning materials and training, rubrics, facilitator guidance, and implementation tasks.
  • Develop model examples and learning resources based on assessment evidence.
  • Improve assessment systems using learner and coordinator feedback.

6. Types of Assessments

The role supports a variety of assessment formats in the sphere of teacher pedagogical training, including:

  • Written reflections and reports
  • Matched submissions across multiple tasks
  • Photos and image-based evidence
  • Videos and transcript-based assessments
  • Observation reports
  • Meeting reports and reflective activities
  • School implementation evidence and documentation

7. Curriculum Quality Assurance

  • Define and revise standards for quality online curriculum and training delivery.
  • Revise Edify online training curricula based on global standards for quality curriculum and training development and delivery.
  • Use data to inform decisions to improve online programming and training across Edify’s training, in collaboration with the CCE Regional Leads in each region.

8. Perform other duties as assigned.

Experience and Education Required:

  • Degree in Education or a related field, graduate degree highly encouraged
  • Cross-cultural competence/experience and alignment with Edify's vision/mission.
  • Experience working in teacher training, professional development, or educational programmes.
  • Experience coordinating assessments, examinations, or learning programmes involving multiple cohorts, countries, or sites.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System to manage learners, assessments, and results.
  • Strong understanding of assessment, marking, moderation, and quality assurance processes.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning design principles.
  • Experience creating training content and curriculum, especially for online environments.
  • Excellent organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple timelines and competing priorities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify and resolve data quality or process issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across programme, technical, and country teams.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement.

Additional Requirements:

  • Personal confession of faith in Jesus Christ and commitment to Edify’s mission
  • Teaching qualification or classroom teaching experience.
  • Experience in teacher professional development or instructional coaching.
  • Experience training markers, facilitators, or coordinators.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted assessment, educational technology, or workflow automation tools.
  • Experience with Google Workspace, Salesforce, or similar digital systems.
  • Ability to travel as needed.

jobs.excerpt: About The Company goop is a lifestyle platform dedicated to exploration, curation, and groundbreaking conversation.
jobs.description:
About The Company

goop is a lifestyle platform dedicated to exploration, curation, and groundbreaking conversation. From its award-winning beauty and fashion lines to its expansive editorial lens, goop invites women to embrace the process of becoming, and to discover deep joy in the pursuit of pleasure, beauty, and growth in all phases of life.

Gwyneth Paltrow began goop in the fall of 2008 as a weekly newsletter. It has expanded into a beauty, fashion, and food business that’s also known for its products, curation, podcast, TV shows, live events, and retail stores.

About You

You operate in founder mode: high agency, high EQ, and razor-sharp instincts. You read the room quickly, sense what's needed before you're asked, and move on it. You are a thoughtful and proactive strategic partner who excels at aligning teams, priorities, and communication — equally comfortable zooming out to understand company-wide operations and strategy, and diving in to drive execution on critical initiatives.

This role represents the Co-CEOs' interests across three worlds: goop's business (beauty & fashion), Gwyneth's media presence, and investment interests. You move fluidly between them, often within the same day.

You are AI-first and AI-native. You don't wait for someone else to build the tool — you build it yourself: standing up Notion dashboards, wiring together plugins and AI agents, and turning no-code experiments into real operational workflows for the Co-CEOs and executive team. With strong communication instincts and sound judgment, you navigate senior stakeholders with confidence and help ensure clarity, alignment, and momentum across the organization.

Who You Are

  • Founder-mode operator — high agency and an ability to act on instinct, before being asked
  • Context-switcher — comfortable moving between all three worlds in the same day
  • Exceptional communicator — confident and clear across formats and audiences
  • Operational powerhouse — you drive structure, efficiency, and accountability in fast-moving, complex environments
  • Sharp writer and researcher — you produce clean, efficient memos, updates, and diligence work that get straight to the point, no fluff
  • Highly collaborative with a good sense of humor — you stay warm, steady, and easy to work with under pressure
  • Highly trustworthy and discreet — you'll handle sensitive information and critical relationships
  • Action-oriented leader — you don't just advise; you own and drive results

How You Operate

  • You operate in full alignment with the Co-CEOs' thinking — when you speak on their behalf, you speak with clarity and conviction, and you recalibrate fast when something's off
  • You extend the Co-CEOs' reach: proactively managing every relationship that matters
  • You communicate early and often — proactive updates are the default, not the exception
  • You're warm and honest — you handle direct communication well and don't avoid hard conversations
  • You assume good intent and offer people the benefit of the doubt — and expect the same in return
  • You understand that small gestures, done right, build long-term trust and relationship equity

About the Role

The Chief of Staff will serve as a strategic partner to goop's Co-CEOs and executive team, driving strategic alignment, execution, and communication across the organization. This role reports directly to the Co-CEOs, representing their interests across three worlds: goop's business (beauty & fashion), Gwyneth's media presence, and investment interests — working across time zones with global, cross-functional teams. The Chief of Staff must be able to shift context across these worlds multiple times in a single day without losing focus or dropping a thread, and ensures the Co-CEOs' priorities are clearly translated into action across each of them — supporting effective executive operations and helping shape company-wide operations, communication, and culture — while owning a high volume of board, portfolio, and investment work across the business.

CO-CEO PARTNERSHIP & STRATEGIC SUPPORT

  • Ensure the Co-CEOs' priorities are clearly communicated across the organization and support the Co-CEOs in driving execution by direct reports and cross-functional teams
  • Act as gatekeeper — knowing when to filter and when to let things flow directly — and, as requested by the Co-CEOs, serve as proxy in key meetings, synthesizing, summarizing, and relaying critical insights to inform decision-making
  • Field, review, prioritize, and, where appropriate, respond to incoming requests, proposals, and opportunities directed to the Co-CEOs
  • Work closely with the Co-CEOs' Executive Assistant(s) to communicate and sequence priorities, manage scheduling trade-offs, and optimize the Co-CEOs' time and focus — across time zones as needed
  • Prepare executive-ready briefings, memos, and presentations — equipping the Co-CEOs with the context, data, and materials needed for internal, board, and external engagements
  • Shape how the Co-CEOs represent the company's strategy and brand to internal teams, the board, media, and external partners
  • Collaborate with the social media team to execute the Co-CEOs' personal social presence across channels, ensuring authenticity, alignment with brand values, and consistency with their voice
  • Partner with the Head of Communications to prepare the Co-CEOs for media appearances and public engagements — building background materials, researching attendees and guests, and managing protocol
  • Coordination with podcast production team, as needed

AI-ENABLED OPERATIONS & SYSTEMS

  • Design, build, and maintain AI-driven systems — including a Co-CEO-facing Notion dashboard layered with plugins and AI agents — serving as the single source of truth for real-time visibility into priorities, decisions, and follow-ups across all three worlds
  • Continuously explore and test new AI tools, plugins, and agents, turning promising ones into practical, repeatable workflows for the Co-CEOs and executive team
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to spot operational bottlenecks and solve them with AI-driven automation and internal tooling
  • Monitor the performance of AI-driven workflows and iterate for continual improvement
  • Build documentation and best practices for AI-enabled operations so tools and workflows scale and transfer beyond any one person

EXECUTIVE TEAM LEADERSHIP & STRATEGIC OPERATIONS

  • Lead and facilitate weekly executive team meetings, including setting clear agendas, driving accountability, and ensuring timely follow-through on action items
  • Meet regularly with senior subject-matter leaders to align on priorities, share Co-CEO context, and ensure cross-functional clarity and collaboration
  • Serve as a trusted strategic partner to every department head — not just the C-suite — translating the Co-CEOs' priorities into function-specific plans and holding cross-functional teams accountable to them
  • Facilitate alignment and communication between the Co-CEOs and direct reports to accelerate decision-making and maintain organizational focus
  • Partner with executive leaders to develop OKRs and track execution against strategic priorities
  • Act as lead strategic project manager on key cross-functional initiatives, ensuring clear ownership, timelines, and outcomes
  • When requested by the Co-CEOs or other executives, contribute to strategic discussions by providing context and insights that reflect Co-CEO and company priorities
  • Capture notes and action items during board and offsite sessions; track follow-ups and ensure accountability across functional leaders
  • Own ambiguous, high-priority special projects that don't have a clear owner — from research sprints to one-off initiatives — and see them through to completion

COMPANY-WIDE COMMUNICATION & CULTURE

  • Shape Co-CEO-led communications for all-company meetings and standups, ensuring alignment with the company's values, strategy, and priorities
  • Partner with the People team to develop monthly standup agendas, coordinating with functional leaders to highlight key initiatives and ensure diverse team representation
  • Partner cross-functionally to source, edit, and align content for company-wide meetings — overseeing slide development and deck design to ensure clarity, consistency, and on-brand voice
  • Prepare the Co-CEOs' talking points and visual aids to support effective delivery and high employee engagement
  • Coordinate logistics and production details to ensure seamless execution of company-wide meetings and events

BOARD, PORTFOLIO & INVESTMENT SUPPORT

  • Drive preparation and execution for quarterly board meetings, including cross-functional coordination for content collection, synthesis, and development of board-ready materials
  • Own end-to-end development of board decks, board presentations, and corporate executive presentations — content, synthesis, and design — ensuring materials are polished and aligned with strategic priorities across goop and goop beauty
  • Build and manage corporate agendas across the business, from executive offsites to board sessions to company-wide meetings
  • Partner with the Co-CEOs and executive team to ensure board discussions and materials are aligned with key strategic priorities and business performance
  • Design and execute off-site retreats — from agenda architecture that balances strategic discussion, business planning, and team-building, to logistics and follow-through on action items
  • Support portfolio management and investment-related workstreams — tracking opportunities, coordinating diligence, and keeping materials current across goop, goop beauty, and Gwyneth's broader investment activities
  • Partner closely with Corporate Development on deal flow, diligence, and new investment or partnership opportunities
  • Collaborate with the Co-CEOs' Executive Assistant(s) on logistics and scheduling, while leading content flow, sequencing, and communication of expectations to the executive tea.
  • Coordinate cross-functional contributors and external facilitators to deliver impactful sessions that advance company goals

CROSS-PORTFOLIO RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT

  • Manage the CRM and contact records — keeping them accurate, deduplicated, and consistently structured (you don't need to build the CRM, but you own how well it runs)
  • Track engagement and relationship health across investors, board members, founders, and key partners — flagging relationships before they go cold
  • Run periodic audits across relationships and initiatives to surface what needs re-engagement, escalation, or a decision from the Co-CEOs
  • Act as the connective tissue across Gwyneth's world — the person who always knows what's happening across all three worlds, and can brief the Co-CEOs on any of them at a moment's notice

Qualifications & Experience

Experience: 3–5 years of business experience, at least 2 years working directly with C-level executives; experience with consumer goods strongly preferred.

Leadership: Proven ability to drive executive programs and high-level strategic initiatives cross-functionally.

Technical Skills: Strong experience with Microsoft suite and data analytics tools. AI-native and fluent with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Notion, Asana, G-Suite, and Airtable, with hands-on experience building and maintaining Notion boards, databases, dashboards, plugins, AI agents, and no-code automations (e.g., Zapier). Experience managing CRM systems and contact records (accuracy, deduplication, structure).

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business required.

Skills: Strong analytical capabilities, financial acumen, and the ability to succeed in a dynamic environment. Comfortable with direct communication, ambiguity, and rapid iteration, and experienced working across time zones with global, cross-functional teams.

FAQ

Compensation: $150,000 – $160,000 + Equity. This is a full-time, exempt role. Please note that this range represents the low and high end of the anticipated base salary range for the Santa Monica, CA or New York, NY based position. Goop, in good faith, reasonably expects to pay the position within this salary range. Goop provides the salary range in compliance with all applicable federal, state and local laws. The actual base salary will depend on numerous factors such as: experience, training, knowledge and skills, and if the location of the job changes.

jobs.excerpt: About UsTemporal is an open source programming model that can simplify code, make applications more reliable, and help developers focus on the important things like delivering features faster.
jobs.description:
About Us

Temporal is an open source programming model that can simplify code, make applications more reliable, and help developers focus on the important things like delivering features faster. We are on a mission to be the reliable foundation of every developer’s toolbox, and are building the team that will make that happen.
Our values guide us —they are present in how we show up, make decisions, and work together to make an impact. We’re curious, driven, collaborative, genuine and humble.
Temporal is growing and we are looking for those who share our values, challenge 'standard' thinking, and want to influence our future. If you have a passion for improving the developer experience, building world-class open-source software and communities, and want to be a part of our amazing team, we'd love to hear from you!

Summary

We have an opening to hire a Software Engineer, AI Foundations.

Temporal provides a reliable foundation powering AI leaders such as OpenAI, NVIDIA, Cursor, Lovable, Replit, and others. Its adoption is also expanding to users spanning across a broad range of AI applications. These range from agents to data pipelines and everything in between.

The mission of the AI Foundations team is to accelerate Temporal adoption across the entire ecosystem. Our approach combines a deep understanding of use cases with technical principles such as computer systems and software design fundamentals.

If you thrive on blending theory and practice, then this is the right team for you. We are an action-oriented group that loves to ship fast and solve customer problems. We also seek thorough technical grounding for our work and invest in systems and practices that foster long-term success.

Agentic development is a huge focus. We maintain a set of agents skills that give Codex, Claude Code, and similar tools a major boost when writing Temporal applications. These are already unblocking a large backlog of projects among our customer base. They also are an extraordinary point of leverage for Temporal’s mission, which has always been about accelerating developers as they build and operate reliable software. Working in this area puts you at the forefront of the agentic coding revolution.

Another major area of investment is our partner ecosystem. We developed a plugin system that makes it easy to add Temporal’s durable execution to popular open source agent frameworks such as Pydantic AI, AI SDK by Vercel, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, and others. Getting these abstractions right involves both creativity and critical trade-off analysis. Many challenges of this flavor remain to be solved. As we make progress, we instill our learnings in our internal AI systems, ensuring that our people are always working to push the frontier.

We await the next AI breakthrough as eagerly as anyone, standing ready to shuffle our short-term priorities at any time. We know, however, that our long-term success and impact comes from attention to technical fundamentals and persistent trends.

Most of Temporal’s work is open source—see for yourself here:

What You Will Do

  • Work as a software engineer
  • Maintain and expand a deep understanding of agentic coding
  • Design and build agentic coding systems that we can trust to deliver high-quality outputs
  • Design and implement Temporal AI SDK features supporting a broad variety of frameworks and libraries.
  • Develop a deep understanding of AI application development patterns and techniques, including emerging approaches and architectures.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of new features, working with other teams to deliver exceptional reliability and a great developer experience.
  • Work with multiple programming languages: Python and TypeScript, Java, Go.
  • Serve as a domain expert on AI design patterns, collaborating with field staff to provide best-practices and canonical examples.
  • Work directly with our developer community to debug issues that need expert attention and get feedback on Temporal features and APIs.
  • Write public technical documentation describing Temporal concepts and APIs.
  • Go the extra mile to support a customer in need, on the rare occasion that our teams’ engineering expertise is needed.
  • Travel to meet your coworkers for a week once or twice a year.
  • Attend the occasional developer conference to talk about how great Temporal is (optional).

What You Won’t Do

  • Work as a Data Scientist, Data Analyst, Devops SWE, or SRE.
  • Work in an office (unless you want to, but you’d be by yourself). Temporal is a fully-remote company.
  • Commit code that’s poorly-tested or works “most of the time”. Temporal aspires to be “Reliable as Gravity”, and we expect our code to be the same.
  • Work behind closed doors. Our work is open source—that means PRs and comments are open to the public, too.
  • Sit in meetings all day. We mostly communicate in writing, and use meetings mainly for status updates and thorny issues that need input from the whole group.
  • Wake up to pager alerts. We’re extremely active in supporting our customers and the community, but we don’t do 24/7 on-call.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of professional work experience and passion for harnessing generative AI, particularly for agents and coding.
  • A deep understanding of how to use AI to increase quality, not only to increase quantity.
  • A sense of taste in code and software development practice. Your approach should be opinionated and thoughtful, but not dogmatic.
  • Fluency in two or more programming languages, and an affinity for learning new ones.
  • Strong experience with concurrent programming—you should know how to use mutexes, atomics, and other concurrency primitives safely.
  • Experience designing APIs and writing documentation for publicly-available libraries or modules.
  • Strong technical communication skills—written and verbal—in English.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science (or a closely-related degree), or equivalent work experience writing production-grade software.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Temporal’s programming model (e.g. you’ve written an app on Temporal).
  • Experience building agents or other AI applications
  • Background in machine learning, model training, data science, or machine learning systems.
  • Experience contributing to the architecture and design of large-scale distributed systems.
  • A track record of open source software contributions, including contributions to 3rd party libraries.
  • Graduate degree in Computer Science.

Compensation

  • The estimated pay range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000.
  • Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Temporal's equity plan.
Compensation ranges reflect salary and commission compensation (when applicable) across several geographic markets. Employment offers carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, knowledge, expertise, skillset, market location, and job level assessed during the interview process.
Employee benefits and perks below are for full-time employees, part-time or temporary positions are excluded.

  • Unlimited PTO, 12 Holidays + 2 Floating Holidays
  • 100% Premiums Coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • AD&D, LT & ST Disability, and Life Insurance (Standard & Supplemental Available)
  • Empower 401K Plan
  • Additional Perks for Learning & Development, Lifestyle Spending, Home Office Setup, Professional Memberships, WFH Meals, Internet Stipend and more!

International Benefits

Paid Time Off (PTO) and Benefits outside the United States vary by country, and are issued in partnership with . Additionally, Temporal offers perks to all international employees for learning & career development, a lifestyle spending account, home office setup, professional memberships, work-from-home meals, and access to the Calm app for mental wellness.

jobs.description:
We are hiring an Investor Relations Associate to help grow the investor side of Paires, the network of family offices and high-net-worth individuals our founders raise from.

Paires is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

The craft of this seat is allocator trust, and we are hiring people early in that craft who are already showing they have it. You will work alongside our senior investor team on live mandates: qualifying allocators, preparing briefs, running follow-ups, and keeping investor relationships warm between deals. And from day one you will build your own: identifying family offices and HNWIs who back US startups, earning first conversations, and growing a book that is yours.

You do not need a decade of relationships. You need the beginnings of a real network, a method for growing it that you can explain, and the discipline to treat other people's capital and privacy with care. The rest, the mandate craft, the briefing standard, the judgment calls, you learn here, working next to people who do this every day. One thing this seat is not: technical. Our engineers build the platform and the agents. You work inside them, so your hours go to investors instead of admin.

What you will own

  • Your growing book. The allocator relationships you bring and the ones you open here, qualified and kept warm.

  • Mandate support that matters. Investor qualification, briefing notes, and follow-through on live deals, done to the house standard.

  • New doors. A monthly rhythm of first conversations with family offices and HNWIs who are new to Paires.

  • Your development. Every investor call you shadow and every brief you write compounds into the senior version of this seat.

You are a fit if you

  • Have started building an allocator network for real, through a seat in wealth management, private banking, a family office, placement, or your own hustle, and can show relationships you opened yourself.

  • Can explain your method. How you find the right investors, how you earn the first conversation, and how you stay useful to them after it.

  • Know what your investors actually do with their money, and ideally that includes direct allocations into US startups.

  • Listen more than you pitch. Allocators trust you because you never waste their time, and you would rather lose a meeting than force one.

  • Treat discretion as a reflex. Names, allocations, and conversations stay confidential, always.

  • Work like it's 2026. AI tooling runs your pipeline and prep, so your hours go to people.

What we offer

Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours, not full US hours. Meetings batch on Mondays and Thursdays, the rest is deep work. The best AI tooling, paid. A senior team to learn the craft from, live deal flow from week one, and a seat that grows into managing your own side of the network.

How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to our short application form. We read every application. Do not include investor names anywhere in it. We evaluate composition, not contacts.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, Mid-Market - Texas, you will lead critical partnerships across midsized school districts in the state to ensure our tools reduce teacher burnout and accelerate student learning at scale. As a Texas market expert and commercial lead, this consultative position involves managing a multimillion-dollar book of business. Key responsibilities include driving customer adoption and leading renewal efforts within the unique Texas educational landscape.

You will oversee complex onboarding and renewal processes, coach teachers and administrators through change, and design interventions that boost adoption.

This role is regional, meaning you should live in Texas and/or bring extensive experience in Texas EdTech (understanding TEA/SBOE dynamics) to be considered for this role.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will own a portfolio of school and district relationships and be responsible for driving the following measurable outcomes:

  • Portfolio Growth and Retention: You will manage a portfolio of approximately 50-75 mid-market districts while maintaining a Net Revenue Retention (NRR) rate above target through strategic price increases and seat expansion.

  • Product Adoption: You will drive active usage across your districts by delivering high-impact training and implementation strategies and creating compelling support materials, such as tutorials and one-pagers, that ensure implementation is scalable and our tools become essential to daily teacher workflows.

  • Churn Mitigation: You will identify at-risk accounts and execute intervention playbooks to maintain a gross churn rate below company thresholds, specifically focusing on a 90 day action plan for high-stakes renewals.

  • Multi-Stakeholder Discovery and Solutioning: You will run structured discovery across district roles and map MagicSchool solutions to each persona's priorities to drive multi-threaded engagement.

  • Strategic Relationship Management: You will build deep trust with district executive leadership, managing accounts through data-driven storytelling and consultative selling.

  • Leadership and Mentorship: You will scale our collective impact by contributing high level insights to the Customer Success playbook, driving cross functional strategy in leadership meetings, and mentoring junior team members to elevate the entire regional organization.

  • Key Metrics of Success

    • Revenue Retention (GRR, NRR)

    • Churn Rate

    • Pilot conversion

    • Expansion Growth

    • Operational Excellence

Qualifications/Competencies/Skills

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring the following skills and competencies:

  • Ownership Mentality: You take full responsibility for your portfolio, working with a high degree of urgency and a bias toward action.

  • Commercial Fluency: You are comfortable leading complex financial negotiations, including discussing contraction risks, pricing adjustments, and expansion opportunities.

  • Texas K-12 Expertise: You possess a deep understanding of the Texas educational landscape.

  • Relationship-Driven: You build deep trust with teachers and district leaders alike.

  • Team Selling Approach: You operate as the "CEO of your accounts," proactively identifying internal resources and mobilizing cross-functional partners to deliver without waiting to be asked.

  • Consultative Discovery and Multi-Stakeholder Management: You run structured discovery across senior district roles (Director of Technology, C&I, ELL, cabinet), translate what you learn into prescriptive, persona-aligned recommendations, and guide district leaders toward the right solution rather than reacting to requests.

  • Book Segmentation & Prioritization: Independently segment your book by ARR, strategic influence, and use case potential to focus time where it drives the most impact.

  • Executive Communication: You are concise, credible, and compelling with senior district leaders. You inspire confidence through clarity.

Experience

Required

  • 3 - 7 years of experience as an individual contributor managing mid-market or enterprise accounts in a SaaS environment, ideally in EdTech

  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding NRR and GRR targets

  • Direct experience leading commercial conversations across renewals, expansion, and pricing

  • Comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder organizations and building relationships at the executive level.

  • Technically proficient in Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

  • Willingness to travel within the state as needed to support district relationships (30%).

Preferred

  • Background in education as a former teacher, coach, or school administrator, a plus

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI technology that directly impacts educators and students.

  • Join a mission-driven team passionate about making education more efficient and equitable.

  • Flexibility of working from home, while fostering a unique culture built on relationships, trust, communication, and collaboration with our team - no matter where they live.

For full time employees:

  • Unlimited time off to empower our employees to manage their work-life balance. We work hard for our teachers and users, and encourage our employees to rest and take the time they need.

  • Choice of employer-paid health insurance plans so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Dental and vision are also offered at very low premiums.

  • Every employee is offered generous stock options, vested over 4 years.

  • 401k match & monthly wellness stipend.

Our Values:

  • Educators are Magic: Educators are the most important ingredient in the educational process - they are the magic, not the AI. Trust them, empower them, and put them at the center of leading change in service of students and families.

  • Joy and Magic: Bring joy and magic into every learning experience - push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI.

  • Community: Foster community that supports one another during a time of rapid technological change. Listen to them and serve their needs.

  • Innovation: The education system is outdated and in need of innovation and change - AI is an opportunity to bring equity, access, and serve the individual needs of students better than we ever have before.

  • Responsibility: Put responsibility and safety at the forefront of the technological change that AI is bringing to education.

  • Diversity: Diversity of thought, perspectives, and backgrounds helps us serve the wide audience of educators and students around the world.

  • Excellence: Educators and students deserve the best - and we strive for the highest quality in everything we do.

Compensation Range: $104K - $120K

Company Overview

LevelUp is a specialist agency providing outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with various companies, offering valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We boast a large team of skilled and passionate professionals committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients.

Position Overview

The Customer Service Specialist plays a pivotal role in delivering outstanding support and ensuring high customer satisfaction through expert problem resolution and clear communication. As a key member of a small, dynamic team, you will act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, technical issues, and feedback. Working closely with leadership, this role requires a proactive, 'doer' mindset, capable of swiftly handling diverse daily tasks, often without pre-existing processes. We seek an empathetic professional with exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, who can meticulously manage customer interactions, escalate complex issues appropriately, and contribute to a positive team environment focused on continuous improvement and customer retention in a fast-paced setting.
Reference: 2631-399721

Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional customer support via email, chat, and other communication channels, ensuring all interactions are professional, helpful, and aligned with company values.
  • Assist customers with inquiries, product guidance, and general support, appropriately escalating complex issues when necessary.
  • Work closely with leadership on various operational and administrative tasks to support daily business operations.
  • Conduct online research and gather information to support business initiatives, projects, and customer requests.
  • Coordinate bookings, appointments, and other required operational activities.
  • Accurately maintain customer records, documentation, and internal systems.
  • Identify recurring customer questions and provide feedback to enhance processes, documentation, and the overall customer experience.
  • Assist in testing new features, workflows, and internal processes, delivering clear feedback to the team.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional team members to ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Promptly and accurately handle arising daily tasks, demonstrating the ability to work effectively without established standard operating procedures.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a customer service, customer support, administration, personal assistant, or operations role.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, possessing the confidence to work independently without direct instruction in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and critical thinking abilities when handling customer inquiries or operational tasks.
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn new systems, tools, and processes; comfort with AI tools and AI-generated text is highly desirable.
  • A positive attitude, willingness to take ownership, and a desire to contribute beyond core responsibilities.
  • Experience working with US clients in a fast-response or on-call setup is highly advantageous.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, suitable for direct, unedited use with US-based clients.
  • A strong team player with a supportive, friendly attitude and a proactive, can-do approach to work.
  • Genuine passion for helping people solve problems, caring about the customer experience, and continuous self-improvement.

Additional Information

  • LevelUp has a company culture that focuses on the well-being of its team members, with a good work life balance and respectful work environment.
  • This is a fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week.
  • Must be able to work full-time during US hours, specifically 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST) and be quick to respond.
  • The exact work schedule depends on the client that you are assigned to so having flexibility when it comes to schedule is important.
  • HMO + 13th month pay
