About the Role

LATAM engineering hiring isn't the quiet, cost-driven move it used to be. More and more AI and software companies are standing up permanent engineering centers across the region, and senior placements have overtaken junior ones. We're doubling down on LATAM technical talent with a Mexico City office in 2027.

This is a chance to own technical recruiting for that build, and sharpen our technical recruiting motion as that bet gets bigger. This hire will be the sole technical recruiter at Kojo with real authority over how we compete for engineering talent in one of the fastest-moving, least-understood talent markets in tech right now.

You partner directly with engineering leadership, work alongside a recruiting coordinator so the logistics don't fall on you alone, and partner with our Director of Talent to hold an increasingly heightened talent bar that determines who builds Kojo's product.

What you'll own

  • Run full-cycle, white-glove recruiting for Kojo's LATAM engineering org, plus occasional NA-based technical searches when they come up.

  • Build an evergreen, competitive outbound pipeline of A+ engineers, identifying high-talent-density teams and coaching hiring managers on how to go after passive candidates the rest of the market isn't reaching.

  • Hold the bar high enough that engineering leadership trusts every name you bring them, and say so when a panel is about to settle.

  • Keep Ashby clean enough that anyone on the team can trust it without a second look.

  • Work AI-natively: Claude, Granola, Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter's AI features, and emerging sourcing tools are part of how you source, screen, and manage pipeline day to day, not an occasional shortcut.

Representative Projects

  • Built the outbound engine behind Kojo's first wave of LATAM engineering hires, senior-heavy from day one, with next to no inbound volume to lean on.

  • Closed a senior engineer against a competing offer from a company paying well above what the market usually requires.

  • Earned enough trust with an engineering leadership team that they started asking for you by name.

About You

You've watched LATAM engineering hiring go from a quiet advantage to one of the most contested plays in tech, and you want to be the person who masters it while everyone else is still catching up. This is the kind of role that turns into a specialty, and a reputation. If you'd rather build the pipeline nobody else has than work off whoever applies, we should talk.

What we're looking for

  • Exceptional ownership and agency to proactively identify pipeline gaps, create momentum on stalled searches, make sound calls with imperfect information, and consistently drive every search across the finish line without waiting for direction (3+ years of full-cycle or coordination recruiting experience required).

  • A keen eye for who's truly great, on and off the resume, and a real stake in whether a hire turns out to be a top performer, not just whether a role gets filled.

  • Proven outbound sourcing credibility, whether it’s a fluency in LinkedIn Recruiter or another sourcing funnel. The most impactful business partners have real opinions on target companies, who's overpaying, who just had layoffs, and where the best underrated senior engineers are, especially now that everyone else is chasing the same names.

  • Technical fluency in the roles you’re hiring for, knowing enough about engineering to earn a Director of Engineering's trust, fast.

  • Genuine care, showing up for candidates as a trusted resource in the market, not simply an interview scheduler

  • Proven stakeholder partnership where hiring managers treat you as part of their team, not an outside vendor filling a req.

  • Someone who wants to be shadowed, takes feedback as fuel, and cares about the recruiting team's success as much as your own.

  • English fluency, since you'll work daily with NA-based engineering leadership and hiring managers.

What you care about

  • Customer Obsession: A candidate's experience is a business need, not a box to check after hours.

  • Passion: You take real pride in who you hire, not just that a role got filled.

  • Accountability: You call out when a panel's about to settle, and you own a search's outcome like it's yours.

Working at Kojo

Salary: Your salary will be dependent upon many factors, including your experience level, skillset, market dynamics and balancing internal equity relative to other Kojo employees. The compensation and benefits information that we provide is based on Kojo’s good-faith estimate as of the date of the job posting and may be modified in the future.

Benefits: This position is also eligible for a new hire equity grant and all US-based full time employees are eligible for our full suite of perks and benefits. For more information about our perks and benefits, check out

Location: Kojo’s team members work from home 100% of the time across North and South America. If applicable, we’ll identify the travel and/or location-specific requirements of a position in the text above. Otherwise, team members can expect to work business hours congruent with their local time zone and remotely.

Inclusive Workplace: Kojo values diverse perspectives and is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, citizenship, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.



Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of Kojo. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Kojo will never ask for any personal account information, such credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Medical Writer / Clinical Document Author

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Medical Writers / Clinical Document Authors to participate in a customer’s project focused on developing advanced AI-assisted writing tools for clinical documentation. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Author and review realistic evaluation tasks based on Clinical Study Reports, DSURs, PSURs/PBRERs, and related clinical documents to inform AI tool development.
  2. Apply expert judgment to assess whether AI-generated content fulfills clinical template and structural requirements, including ICH E3 organization, section sequencing, cross-referencing, and appendix management.
  3. Evaluate scientific accuracy in narrative sections such as efficacy, safety summaries, discussion, and conclusions, distinguishing true scientific or interpretive errors from stylistic differences.
  4. Trace narrative claims to source records—tables, figures, listings, and protocols—to verify that all assertions are appropriately supported.
  5. Provide clear and structured written rationales for each assessment, enabling precise diagnosis and improvement of AI model behavior.
  6. Collaborate with project leads to refine evaluation frameworks and document best practices for clinical regulatory writing in the context of AI.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Minimum 5 years of regulatory medical writing experience at a sponsor, CRO, or as an independent consultant.
  2. Direct experience independently authoring or leading the authoring of full Clinical Study Reports, beyond summaries or partial contributions.
  3. Fluency with ICH E3 and conventions for periodic safety documentation (ICH E2F, ICH E2C) and eCTD placement.
  4. Demonstrated ability to read and interpret TFLs and protocol documents, identifying where narrative diverges from source data.
  5. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, especially in providing structured, actionable feedback on clinical content.
  6. Advanced degree in life sciences, pharmacy, or medicine (PhD, PharmD, MD, MSc), or equivalent depth of authoring experience.
  7. Experience across multiple clinical phases and therapeutic areas; oncology and haematology expertise is especially valued.

Join our customer's team and leverage your authoring expertise to help design the next generation of AI-assisted clinical documentation solutions. This high-bar role offers you the chance to shape how tomorrow's writing teams draft and review regulatory documents — through your expert input, judgment, and real-world experience.

jobs.excerpt: Staff AccountantSnapshot of Curvion BlueCurvion Blue is a high-performance revenue operations and sales augmentation company that helps businesses build, optimize, and scale their revenue engines.
jobs.description:
Staff Accountant

Snapshot of Curvion Blue

Curvion Blue is a high-performance revenue operations and sales augmentation company that helps businesses build, optimize, and scale their revenue engines.

We operate in a fast-moving environment with numerous companies, brands, offers, sales teams, vendors, and revenue relationships moving through our financial systems. Our accounting function needs to be accurate, organized, proactive, and capable of handling complexity at scale.

We're looking for a Staff Accountant who is more than a transaction processor. We need someone who can own day-to-day accounting responsibilities, manage a high volume of financial activity, reconcile complex transactions, accurately administer commissions, and identify issues before they become problems.

Experience in an agency, BPO, outsourced accounting firm, SaaS company, sales organization, marketplace, or another high-volume financial environment is highly preferred.

Position Overview

The Staff Accountant is responsible for maintaining accurate, timely, and well-documented financial records across Curvion Blue's operations.

This role supports a high-volume, multi-company financial environment where billing, revenue, payments, and sales commissions flow across dozens of external companies, brands, offers, and revenue relationships.

The Staff Accountant will own or support core accounting workflows across:

  • Accounts payable

  • Accounts receivable

  • Billing and invoicing

  • Revenue reconciliation

  • Sales commissions

  • Payroll and commission schedules

  • Credit cards and expenses

  • Cash and banking

  • Account reconciliations

  • Month-end close

  • Financial reporting support

The right person is highly organized, analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently. They should be able to look across large amounts of financial data and quickly identify when something doesn't tie out, doesn't make sense, or doesn't match the underlying agreement.

You should naturally ask:

"What should this number be, and why isn't it?"

rather than simply entering what is in front of you.

You SHOULD Apply If

  • You have experience managing high-volume accounting activity across multiple companies, entities, customers, vendors, or revenue streams.

  • You have experience with sales commissions, variable compensation, or commission reconciliation.

  • You have experience with billing, invoicing, AR, and revenue reconciliation.

  • You are comfortable working with large amounts of transactional data.

  • You have worked in an agency, BPO, outsourced accounting firm, SaaS company, sales organization, marketplace, or other fast-paced environment.

  • You are exceptionally detail-oriented and naturally notice when something doesn't reconcile.

  • You can investigate discrepancies rather than simply flagging them.

  • You can manage recurring deadlines without constant follow-up.

  • You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

  • You communicate quickly when something is wrong or when you need additional information.

  • You enjoy improving processes rather than simply following them.

  • You can move quickly without sacrificing accuracy.

You SHOULD NOT Apply If

  • You need someone to give you a checklist for every task.

  • You have only worked in low-volume accounting environments and are uncomfortable with a high volume of transactions.

  • You have little experience with reconciliations or investigating discrepancies.

  • You consider accounting "done" once transactions have been entered.

  • You regularly discover problems only after someone else points them out.

  • You struggle to manage competing deadlines.

  • You are uncomfortable working with commission calculations or variable compensation.

  • You prefer highly repetitive work with little ownership or problem-solving.

  • You are not comfortable communicating proactively in a remote environment.

What You'll Own

Accounts Payable

  • Maintain accurate AP records and trackers as invoices are received.

  • Review invoices for accuracy, coding, approvals, and appropriate documentation.

  • Process electronic payments and checks according to established approval procedures.

  • Maintain accurate vendor records and contact information.

  • Collect and maintain current W-9s and applicable vendor documentation.

  • Validate vendor banking information before electronic payments are initiated.

  • Monitor outstanding payables and ensure payments are processed on schedule.

  • Identify unusual, duplicate, or potentially fraudulent transactions and escalate appropriately.

Accounts Receivable & Billing

  • Create and distribute invoices according to established billing schedules and agreements.

  • Reconcile customer payments against invoices and supporting documentation.

  • Maintain accurate customer and company records.

  • Monitor outstanding receivables and support collection efforts.

  • Investigate payment discrepancies, unapplied cash, short payments, and billing variances.

  • Reconcile amounts billed and collected against applicable contracts, SOWs, agreements, or other supporting documentation.

  • Identify billing issues before they become larger collection or revenue problems.

  • Support accurate revenue reporting across multiple companies and revenue streams.

Sales Commissions

  • Prepare and maintain commission schedules across multiple companies, brands, offers, and compensation structures.

  • Calculate commissions accurately based on applicable agreements, sales activity, payment status, and other compensation requirements.

  • Reconcile commission calculations against source data and supporting documentation.

  • Investigate discrepancies between sales activity, revenue collected, and commissions owed.

  • Maintain accurate records of commission calculations and supporting documentation.

  • Prepare commission schedules for review and approval.

  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders when commission information is incomplete or inconsistent.

  • Identify recurring commission issues and recommend process improvements.

Payroll & Compensation

  • Prepare payroll and commission schedules for review and approval.

  • Process approved payroll accurately and according to established deadlines.

  • Reconcile payroll activity against accounting records.

  • Review variable compensation calculations and supporting documentation for accuracy.

  • Investigate discrepancies and escalate unresolved issues promptly.

  • Maintain appropriate documentation for payroll and compensation transactions.

Credit Cards & Expenses

  • Enter and categorize credit card transactions accurately.

  • Collect and maintain receipts and supporting documentation.

  • Reconcile credit card activity to monthly statements.

  • Identify missing receipts, unusual transactions, duplicate charges, or coding discrepancies.

  • Ensure credit card payments are processed by their due dates.

  • Reconcile employee reimbursements against supporting documentation.

Cash & Banking

  • Reconcile bank transactions to accounting records and supporting documentation.

  • Investigate discrepancies and ensure issues are resolved promptly.

  • Monitor cash activity and identify unusual or unexpected transactions.

  • Maintain accurate cash flow reporting and forecasts.

  • Reconcile intercompany activity where applicable.

  • Ensure bank and cash balances are properly reflected in the financial records.

Month-End Close

  • Own assigned components of the month-end close process and meet established deadlines.

  • Perform initial P&L reviews and identify unusual fluctuations or inconsistencies.

  • Prepare journal entries and supporting documentation.

  • Reconcile balance sheet accounts to source documents and subledgers.

  • Review financial activity for completeness and accuracy.

  • Prepare draft financial reporting packages and supporting schedules.

  • Review financial results against contracts, invoices, payroll, commissions, and other source documentation.

  • Roll forward recurring schedules and maintain accurate month-end workbooks.

  • Support quarterly and annual accounting requirements, including sales tax and year-end reporting.

  • Document changes to processes and accounting procedures.

Financial Accuracy & Controls

You will be expected to serve as an additional layer of quality control within the accounting function.

That means you will:

  • Review transactional data for irregularities, unusual activity, and inconsistencies.

  • Investigate discrepancies rather than simply correcting the symptom.

  • Maintain clean and complete supporting documentation.

  • Protect confidential financial, payroll, employee, and company information.

  • Safeguard accounting system access and credentials.

  • Monitor for potential fraud and escalate concerns immediately.

  • Maintain clear audit trails and documentation.

  • Identify opportunities to improve financial controls and reduce errors.

  • Research accounting questions and applicable rules when necessary.

  • Recommend improvements to accounting processes, systems, and controls.

You SHOULD Be Comfortable With

  • High-volume transaction environments.

  • Managing financial activity across dozens of companies, customers, vendors, or revenue relationships.

  • Sales commissions and variable compensation.

  • Billing and revenue reconciliation.

  • Multiple recurring deadlines.

  • AP and AR workflows.

  • Payroll and commission cycles.

  • Bank and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Month-end close.

  • Identifying and investigating discrepancies.

  • Working with contracts, SOWs, invoices, and other financial source documentation.

  • Remote collaboration and asynchronous communication.

  • Learning new financial systems and technology quickly.

  • Building and improving accounting processes.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Understand Curvion Blue's accounting structure, systems, companies, offers, and financial workflows.

  • Build strong working relationships with the Accounting Manager, Controller, and key internal stakeholders.

  • Learn the company's billing, commission, reconciliation, and close processes.

  • Consistently meet assigned deadlines.

  • Demonstrate strong attention to detail and follow-through.

First 60 Days

  • Independently own recurring accounting responsibilities.

  • Consistently maintain accurate AP, AR, billing, commission, banking, credit card, and reconciliation workflows.

  • Identify discrepancies proactively and communicate issues before they become problems.

  • Demonstrate strong command of the company's accounting systems and processes.

  • Reliably manage multiple companies, revenue streams, and competing priorities.

First 90 Days

  • Reliably own assigned accounting functions with minimal oversight.

  • Consistently deliver accurate work on time, including during month-end close.

  • Accurately manage commission and revenue reconciliation across a high volume of transactions.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and controls.

  • Demonstrate the ability to manage complexity without sacrificing accuracy.

  • Become someone the Accounting Manager and Controller can trust to see the problem before it becomes a fire drill.

Primary Performance KPIs

  • 100% on-time completion of assigned accounting deadlines.

  • 98%+ accuracy across assigned accounting workflows.

  • 100% completion of assigned month-end close responsibilities by deadline.

  • 100% of assigned reconciliations completed accurately and on schedule.

  • 98%+ accuracy across commission calculations and schedules.

  • Zero avoidable late payments resulting from missed accounting deadlines.

  • Timely identification and escalation of material discrepancies.

  • Complete and organized supporting documentation for assigned transactions and reconciliations.

  • Consistent adherence to accounting controls and established processes.

Communication & Ownership Expectations

  • Communicate accounting issues promptly rather than allowing them to linger.

  • Respond to internal communications within one business day, even when the final answer is still pending.

  • Clearly communicate competing priorities, blockers, and deadlines.

  • Keep the Accounting Manager and Controller informed of material discrepancies or unusual activity.

  • Take ownership of assigned responsibilities from beginning to end.

  • Proactively follow up on outstanding information required to complete accounting responsibilities.

  • Maintain confidentiality around financial, payroll, employee, and company information.

  • Work effectively in a remote environment with high levels of autonomy.

  • Maintain accurate records, calendars, task lists, and deadlines.

  • Escalate issues when appropriate while making a reasonable effort to investigate and resolve them independently first.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of accounting experience.

  • Strong understanding of general accounting principles.

  • Experience with AP, AR, billing, reconciliations, and month-end close.

  • Experience working with high-volume financial transactions.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organization.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Highly Preferred

  • Experience with sales commissions or variable compensation.

  • Experience reconciling revenue, payments, commissions, or billing across multiple companies or revenue streams.

  • Experience in an agency, BPO, outsourced accounting, fractional accounting, SaaS, marketplace, or sales environment.

  • Experience working with US-based companies or US GAAP.

  • Experience managing financial activity across multiple entities or business relationships.

  • Experience with contract/SOW-based billing.

  • Experience with accounting software such as QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, or similar platforms.

  • Experience with systems such as Gusto, , Ramp, Brex, Stripe, or similar financial platforms.

  • Experience supporting a rapidly growing company.

The Bottom Line

We're not looking for someone whose definition of success is simply:

"I completed my accounting tasks."

We're looking for someone who takes ownership of the financial operation, keeps the numbers clean, catches inconsistencies, understands the relationship between revenue and commissions, meets deadlines, communicates proactively, and continuously looks for ways to make the accounting function better.

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys complexity, volume, and problem-solving.

If you're the kind of accountant who sees a number that doesn't make sense and can't leave it alone until you figure out why, we want to talk to you.

This job requires working 9am-6pm PST hours and time zone

Why Sentact

You hold yourself to a high bar, communicate clearly under pressure, and treat every order as a reflection of the standard we’ve built. jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

Nemours Radiology is seeking three additional Pediatric Radiologists to join our current overnight group as a 100% remote nighthawk, 1 week on and 2 weeks off model. This position is 100% pediatric imaging, with no fluoroscopy responsibilities, and the provider will be paired with an additional radiologist overnight. Emergency neuroradiology experience is preferred but not required. We offer a competitive salary and generous signing bonus.

Division Highlights

Nemours Radiology is one of the largest pediatric radiology groups in the United States, currently composed of 46 pediatric radiologists, growing to over 50 in 2026, working together to provide state-of-the-art diagnostic and interventional radiology services at our locations in Delaware, Florida, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. In 2025, we are on track to preform 500,000 imaging examinations across the growing system. The enterprise is integrated within a single PACS, with faculty working from shared worklists, participating in multi-site conferences and initiatives, and sharing after-hours responsibilities including a current dedicated team of 3 nighthawk radiologists. We have collaborative research opportunities supported by dedicated leadership, PhD’s, and a radiology research fellowship. We are also active educationally with Pediatric Radiology and Pediatric Neuroradiology fellowships at our Orlando, FL and Wilmington, DE campuses and radiology residents from multiple programs rotating through the department. Pediatric Radiology fellows are expected to rotate with the nighthawk team during their fellowship year.

Nemours Radiology provides full pediatric imaging services (diagnostic and interventional) for Nemours Children’s Hospital, Delaware, in Wilmington, Nemours Children’s Hospital, Florida, in Orlando, Nemours Children’s Specialty Care in Jacksonville, FL, Nemours Children’s Clinic at Studer Family Children's Hospital at Ascension Sacred Heart in Pensacola, FL, Wolfson Children’s Hospital in Jacksonville, FL as well as several hospital partners for pediatric radiology. Faculty are licensed in all four states and credentialed throughout the system as well as partner institutions. In-house moonlighting is also available.

Academic appointment is available but not required for our emergency radiology section.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base compensation
  • Comprehensive benefits: health, life, dental, vision
  • Mortgage assistance, relocation packages and 403B with employer match, 457 retirement savings plan
  • Licensure, CME and dues allowance
  • Not-for-profit status; eligibility for Public Service Loan Forgiveness

jobs.description:
Product Support Associate (Tier 1 Support) — 2 Openings
Preferred locations: Philippines (or similar UTC+8 region) + Central America (UTC-6)

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our proprietary computer-vision system enables staff to automate documentation, proactively manage resident acuity, and streamline workflows across entire facilities. Our platform delivers unprecedented access to real-time data insights, empowering healthcare providers with actionable intelligence to enhance decision-making and elevate care delivery.

The Role

As Teton's Product Support Associate, you'll serve as the front line of Tier 1 support for our Customer Success organization- monitoring support channels, triaging incoming issues, and resolving or routing them fast so CS can stay focused on client relationships and outcomes rather than operational firefighting.

We're hiring Product Support Associates, each based in a time zone that complements US coverage hours, so that between the two roles and the US team, support is covered around the clock.

You'll own first response across support channels, working from defined SOPs to investigate, categorize, and resolve straightforward issues, and to escalate complex ones to the right team (CS, Engineering, Deployment, or Product) with clear, well-documented context.

This is a foundational role on a growing Support function- you'll help build on the playbooks as much as follow it, and there's a clear path to more ownership as the team scales into Phase 2.

Key Responsibilities

In this role you will lead and oversee:

First response- monitor all regional support channels and respond to inbound support messages

Ticket triage- investigate issues, categorize by type (Detection, App, Connectivity, Desktop, Hardware), and create Support or Hardware Maintenance tickets per existing SOP

Engineering escalation- create well-documented engineering tickets where required and tag the appropriate teams

Install validation- assist the deployment teams to confirm hardware is online and correctly set up post-install in coordination.

Device monitoring- check device online/offline status, flag anomalies, and take defined first-response actions

Source trigger routing- keep up with source trigger events and route them appropriately based on initial investigation

Schedule

Shift length: 8 hours/day, 5 days/week covering UK morning/US overnight + UK evening/US daytime

Weekend coverage: Every other weekend, with the two Support Associates alternating so one is always on for weekend coverage

What We're Looking For

Minimum Qualifications: 1–2 years of experience in a Tier 1 IT help desk or technical support role

Comfort with SaaS support tooling and structured ticket workflows

Strong written English, with the ability to communicate clearly with healthcare facility staff at varying levels of tech literacy

High attention to detail, ability to follow defined escalation protocols, and self-directed during shifts with minimal overlap with the core US team

Mindset:

You're energized by working alongside an international team that moves fast and turns technology into real workflow wins with clients

Direct, transparent communicator who escalates early, brings solutions with the problem, and wants teammates who operate the same way

You thrive in rapid iteration and don't need a finished process to do great work

Genuinely curious about AI, computer vision, and how emerging technology actually lands in healthcare settings

You want to do the best work of your career at a company that's genuinely changing how care gets delivered

Preferred Qualifications:

Healthcare or senior living familiarity- willingness to learn Teton's clinical context quickly

Experience with Slack-based or similar support workflows and structured handoff processes

Prior experience at an early-stage SaaS or healthcare technology company

Prior experience working a shift-based or follow-the-sun support schedule, including weekend rotations

What We Offer

Competitive Salary and participation in our warrant program.

Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

401(k) plan, paid time off, health insurance.

What It's Like Working at Teton

We're a growing team of extremely hard-working and talented people. The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged- it's expected. It's a hands-on environment where you'll be challenged, supported, and constantly learning.

We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job. With us you will have an opportunity to truly make an impact on the world with the outcomes of your work. So, if you are looking for a ride and not just a job – jump on board 😊

JOB SUMMARY:

The Excess Liability Insurance Underwriter evaluates, selects, and prices excess and surplus (E&S) casualty risks within delegated underwriting authority. This is a technical carrier underwriting role focused on sound risk selection, disciplined pricing, portfolio profitability, and documentation quality across a broad range of target classes including contracting/wrap-up/project-specific risks, product liability, service classes, real estate, and institutional exposures. The underwriter works within the carrier’s underwriting guidelines and appetite to make binding decisions on new business, renewals, and endorsements.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

Sound Judgment & Underwriting Authority: Exercises disciplined analytical thinking to evaluate complex excess casualty risk exposures and make binding underwriting decisions within delegated authority limits. Balances risk quality with portfolio profitability.

Technical Underwriting Depth: Demonstrates strong command of excess and surplus lines casualty underwriting principles, coverage structures, attachment points, and pricing methodology across multiple target classes.

Portfolio & Market Awareness: Monitors loss trends, emerging risks, and E&S market conditions to proactively adjust underwriting strategies and maintain a profitable, disciplined book of business.

Broker & Carrier Collaboration: Builds and maintains effective working relationships with wholesale brokers and internal carrier teams. Communicates underwriting decisions clearly, including rationale for pricing, coverage structure, or declinations.

Attention to Detail & Documentation: Thoroughly reviews applications, loss history, and exposure data. Produces clear, accurate underwriting files that reflect sound decision-making and comply with carrier guidelines, surplus lines regulations, and audit standards.

DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

Risk Assessment & Underwriting Authority

  • Analyze complex excess casualty risk submissions, including underlying primary programs, loss history, and exposure data
  • Evaluate risks across target classes including contracting/wrap-up/project-specific, product liability, service classes, real estate, and institutional exposures
  • Underwrite excess and surplus (E&S) lines submissions that fall outside standard market appetite
  • Make binding decisions on new business, renewals, and endorsements within delegated underwriting authority
  • Determine appropriate coverage structures, attachment points, limits, terms, conditions, and endorsements in accordance with underwriting guidelines
  • Refer risks outside delegated authority to senior underwriting leadership with a clear, documented recommendation
  • Apply surplus lines regulatory knowledge in structuring and transacting placements appropriately

Portfolio & Profitability Management

  • Maintain a profitable book of business through disciplined risk selection and consistent application of underwriting guidelines
  • Monitor loss trends, emerging risks, and E&S market conditions to adjust underwriting strategies
  • Collaborate with carrier actuarial teams to refine pricing models and ensure rate adequacy
  • Identify and escalate portfolio-level concerns, deteriorating segments, or appetite shifts to leadership
  • Participate in audits and internal reviews to ensure compliance with underwriting standards

Broker Engagement

  • Maintain effective working relationships with wholesale brokers within the carrier’s distribution model
  • Communicate underwriting decisions clearly and professionally, including rationale for pricing, structure, or coverage changes
  • Provide guidance to brokers on risk characteristics, carrier appetite, and submission requirements
  • Represent the carrier at industry events, broker meetings, and training sessions as appropriate

Documentation & Compliance

  • Prepare clear, accurate underwriting files that document the basis for each binding decision
  • Ensure all transactions adhere to surplus lines regulatory requirements, internal policies, and delegated authority limits
  • Maintain thorough knowledge of underwriting guidelines, carrier appetite, and state-specific insurance laws
  • Stay current on legal developments and emerging excess casualty liability trends

REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES:

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in excess casualty or surplus lines underwriting
  • Experience making binding underwriting decisions within a delegated authority framework
  • Strong technical knowledge of E&S casualty coverage structures, attachment points, and pricing methodology
  • Ability to analyze complex risk submissions, loss data, and exposure information to reach sound underwriting conclusions
  • Solid understanding of surplus lines regulations and E&S market placement

Preferred

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

Компанія має власний інженерний, технічний, сервісний та інсталяційний підрозділ, що дає можливість контролювати якість процесу впровадження проєктів на всіх етапах реалізації.

З метою забезпечення реалізації динамічно зростаючого портфеля проєктів нашого Партнера ми знаходимось в пошуку Інженера-проектувальника, який зможе брати участь у всьому циклі проектування B2B СЕС проєктів компанії.

Основні обов'язки:

  • Підготовка ТЗ на проєктування
  • Підготовка ескізних проєктних рішень (розміщення обладнання, схеми, специфікація)
  • Розробка проектної документації для побудови СЕС: ПЗ, розміщення фотомодулів, планів прокладання ліній DС та АС, схеми підключення інверторів та АКБ, схеми автоматизації та синхронізації з ДЕС, кабельні журнали, специфікації обладнання та матеріалів
  • Розрахунок генерації
  • Погодження проєктів з представниками технічної служби замовника та/або з експертизою (за домовленістю)
  • Ведення авторського нагляду за реалізацією проєкту (за домовленістю)

Кваліфікація та професійний досвід:

  • Вища технічна освіта (бажано електротехнічна)
  • Досвід роботи інженером-проектувальником
  • Володіння ПЗ:
    - AutoCAD для створення 2D креслень (обов'язково)
    - PVSyst для формування звітів, зокрема з погодинної генерації (є перевагою)
    - SketchUp для прив'язки геолокації, формування затінень, створення анімації (є перевагою)
    - Плагін Skelion для розкладання фотомодулів, розрахунку генерації, створення моделей власних ФЕМ (є перевагою)
  • Знання вимог Правил улаштування електроустановок (ПУЕ)
  • Знання вимог до оформлення проектної документації згідно ДБН
  • Розрахунок втрат напруги та підбір перерізу кабелів
  • Знання типів кріплень ФЕМ до покрівлі (розуміння вузлів)
  • Знання схем релейного управління (АВР, реле запуску генератора, перемикання ліній як автоматично, так і за допомогою перемикачів)
  • Знання організації ліній зв'язку між інверторами, смартлогерами, лічильниками, трансформаторами струму
  • Досвід роботи з різними типами сонячного обладнання: знання складових СЕС, вимог та стандартів, щодо їх встановлення, підключення та експлуатації

Є додатковою перевагою:

  • Наявність сертифіката проектувальника СС1-СС3
  • Наявність сертифікатів від виробників обладнання про знайомство з характеристиками їх обладнання
  • Знання англійської мови (для ознайомлення з технічною документацією)

Якщо Ви є досвідченим Інженером-проектувальником у галузі сонячної енергетики та відкриті до гнучкої проєктної співпраці, будь ласка, надішліть своє резюме на з темою листа "PV Design Engineer (Freelance, UA)", та ми надамо Вам більш детальну інформацію про цю пропозицію.

PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

  • Supporting the development of a single, automated, end-to-end machine learning flywheel for the entire Waymo Driver. This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who builds with code as naturally as they build with spreadsheets — and who is energized by replacing manual workflows with automated, scalable infrastructure. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

As a Director of Growth Strategy, you will be responsible for a small portfolio of game-changing brands that have engaged with Darkroom to accelerate their growth. You are one-half management consultant — spending your day dissecting inefficiencies within the business and marketing programs — and one-half marketing strategy leader, building and orchestrating a Darkroom team meant to deliver growth. This is a client-facing position meant for the best and brightest in growth marketing and media strategy, capable of leveraging their unique skillset.

Perfect candidates will be obsessed with growth strategy for consumer brands, experts at deploying efficient omni-channel paid advertising campaigns that deliver impact, with particular expertise in and knowledge growing the DTC channel at large. You should be comfortably managing the go-to-market for fast-growth emerging brands pre-revenue as equally as managing a $50M DTC P&L for a household consumer brand.

This position is the most senior position on a Darkroom omni-channel client engagement (meaning the client may be working with us across multiple sales channels — Amazon, DTC, TikTok Shop, Retail). Being successful in this role requires mastery of the DTC function, a willingness to understand (and master) how integrated paid media drives growth impact on the other channels (Amazon, Retail), and effective communication across teams and departments. You will be Directly managing the relationship with the client, scaling ad accounts upwards of $1M USD per month, and having excellent client relationship management skills. You live and growth strategy, funnel construction, and performance marketing. You want to be a part of the best team in the business at scaling brands through digital advertising.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of the department and play a key role in scaling Darkroom’s footprint across a portfolio of high-growth consumer brands. You’ll be responsible for owning full funnel advertising efforts, including weekly client team touch-bases and QBRs, while working closely with all Darkroom teams to ensure performance goals are met.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands-on experience in a broad range of verticals, while developing the skills needed to be a future CMO.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop integrated growth strategies that deliver millions in yearly growth for clients.

  • Developing campaigns where all marketing channels are working together and be able to clearly articulate overall themes as well as trends across the paid media plan.

  • Work on financial projections, budgets, P&L, and other financial documents to be shared internally, with the client, and used as a north star for work.

  • Work with our data team to deliver financial projections, customer cohort analyses, and media plans.

  • Work with Darkroom Finance team to project client spend and increase it based on performance.

  • Leverage these data insights to develop unique marketing strategies across various industries.

  • Lead multiple teams of designers, paid acquisition marketers, retention marketers, and data analysts across the globe for your client portfolio.

  • Work with Darkroom success to develop fractional and dedicated marketing org charts based on client needs.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 10+ years of paid media experience with a minimum of 7 years in DTC or E-Commerce.

  • You are a master of the DTC P&L and are comfortable engaging in discussions around contribution margin, new customer revenue, and repeat revenue.

  • You understand revenue is a derivative of AOV, CVR, CPM, Traffic and can articulate this in a marketing pro-forma.

  • You have a great willingness to understand (and master) how integrated paid media drives growth impact on the other channels (Amazon, Retail), not just DTC.

  • You are a master of constructing e-commerce funnels that include irresistible offers, healthy AOV, and speak to the UVPs of a product. You can build creative strategies off these funnels and communicate them clearly to the client.

  • You are excited by complex challenges that require innovative marketing strategies to unlock scale.

  • Your 5-10 year plan has you becoming a CMO or CEO of your own brand.

  • You are excited by the challenge to work at the intersection of growth marketing, creative advertising, and financial analysis.

  • You have an acute attention to detail and are capable of project managing large teams with various functions.

  • You are able to be flexible, understand shifting client needs, deal with ambiguity, and adapt to the situation.

  • You are not afraid to be a leader and deliver thoughtful direction that keeps projects on track.

  • You are proficient in financial projections, dealing with P/Ls, and holding your own with Private Equity firms, CEOs, CFOs, or a management team when challenged to defend your strategies surrounding marketing movements and paths to scale.

  • You are excited to work with innovative data models that give you unique insights into product, customer, and marketing data. You thrive on this data to develop new strategies.

  • Know the entire acquisition marketing landscape, and have a perspective on how to build world-class campaigns in today’s changing landscape – this includes knowledge of the tools to use, running effective campaigns, the metrics to measure, and the proper attribution methodologies

  • You like building teams and are comfortable being the quarterback, directing retention, paid media, creative, and data teams in harmony to deliver efficient growth.

  • Experience in online sales channel strategies; Shopify, Amazon, third-party fulfillment, and wholesale.

  • You understand media measurement and the differences between MTA, MMM, and In Platform attribution. You are keen to figure out how best to think about measurement for your clients.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Our Hiring Process and Compensation:

The hiring process for this position typically follows three stages; phone screen, hiring manager, and Executive calls.

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $140,000 per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York, including New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for performance-based compensation.   • Master’s degree, preferred

  • Business management, strategic marketing planning, digital marketing

Team member produces high quality work, meets organizational and departmental deadlines, balances multiple responsibilities, manages time effectively, and seeks ways to improve processes and productivity

In addition to the above, supervisors will successfully manage team projects and deadlines, foster a positive team culture, empower autonomy, and balance team workload effectively

COMMUNICATION

Team member communicates clearly in written and verbal formats, collaborates effectively, demonstrates professionalism in all interactions, exhibits strong interpersonal skills, and contributes to a positive team and professional community

In addition to the above, supervisors will model strong communication skills and leverage interpersonal skills to build relationships and sustain a strong professional community

CUSTOMER FOCUS

Team member addresses the needs of internal and external customers, analyzes problems effectively, contributes to innovative solutions, seeks opportunities for improvement, and successfully adapts to change

In addition to the above, supervisors will create and support action plans and strategies to achieve organizational goals, make informed decisions, promote innovative solutions, and anticipate future trends and challenges

DIRECTOR COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS:

LEARNING ON THE FLY

Learns quickly when facing new problems; Is a voracious learner; Analyzes both successes and failures for clues to improvement; Experiments and will try anything to find solutions; Seeks out the challenge of unfamiliar tasks; Quickly grasps the essence and the underlying structure of most anything

PRESENTATION SKILLS

Is effective in a variety of formal presentation settings: one-on-one, small and large groups, with peers, direct reports, and bosses; Is effective both inside and outside the organization, on both cool data and hot and controversial topics; Commands attention and can manage group process during the presentation; Can change tactics midstream when something isn’t working

PRIORITY SETTING

Spends his/her time and the time of others on what’s important; Quickly zeros in on the critical few and puts the trivial many aside; Can quickly sense what will help or hinder accomplishing a goal; Eliminates roadblocks; Creates focus

BUSINESS & FINANCIAL ACUMEN

Knowledgeable in current and possible future policies, practices, trends, technology, and information affecting his/her business and organization; Knows the competition; Understands and communicates the goals, objectives, competencies, and metrics associated with business success; Understands and applies knowledge of key organizational business drivers; Keeps abreast of the overall performance of the organization and adjusts allocation of finances based on progress against goals; Sets priorities by aligning organizational finances with strategic goals; Fosters an environment that encourages fiscal responsibility

COMPOSURE

Is cool under pressure; Does not become defensive or irritated when times are tough; Can be counted on to hold things together during tough times; Handles stress well; Is not knocked off balance by the unexpected; Doesn’t show frustration when resisted or blocked; Is a settling influence in a crisis; Consistently behaves in a professional manner

DEALING WITH AMBIGUITY

Effectively copes with change; Can shift gears comfortably; Can decide and act without having the total picture; Isn’t upset when things are up in the air; Doesn’t have to finish things before moving on; Can comfortably handle risk and uncertainty

jobs.description:
About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers across South & Southeast Asia.

You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users.

Hiring in: Bangkok, Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Colombo, Bali, Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Phuket and Pattaya.

The Job

  • Explore and discover great cafes: Visit assigned cafes across your city, experience them as a customer, and identify places that travellers would genuinely enjoy working from.

  • Collect high-quality on-ground data: Verify key details including WiFi availability, internet speed, passwords, plug points, seating, ambience and overall work-friendliness to ensure the information is accurate and reliable.

  • Contribute to a travel product used by thousands: Capture your observations by completing a short digital survey after every visit, helping build one of the world's most reliable databases of work-friendly cafes.

  • Cover your city efficiently: Plan your visits across assigned neighbourhood clusters to maximize coverage while maintaining consistency and quality.

  • Maintain exceptional data quality: Pay close attention to detail, validate every submission, and ensure the information travellers see on the Atlys app can be trusted.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a college student or have a flexible part-time schedule.

  • Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places.

  • Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately.

  • Are comfortable travelling independently within your city.

  • Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven.

What you can expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

  • Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

  • A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

  • Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

  • Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

  • Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

  • Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

  • An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than 3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

As a Product Manager at Roo, you'll be an embedded builder on a squad focused on driving impact across our labor marketplace. You won't just write specs and hand them off - you'll use AI tools to compress research cycles, prototype ideas, and increasingly ship work directly. You'll support the strategy and execution of meaningful product work, collaborating closely with engineering, design, analytics, and operations to deliver value to our users. This is a role for someone who gets their energy from building, takes ownership of their work, and is hungry to solve real problems for real people in a collaborative environment.

Your work will connect directly to the "Roo Equation"—the equation that defines our business model—so you'll always know you're having an impact. You'll operate with growing autonomy as you take an iterative, curiosity and AI-driven approach to learning, moving fast, and shipping product that creates measurable outcomes for our customers.

This role reports to the Director of Product Management, and while the role will operate on a remote basis, you may be required to occasionally be onsite in our San Francisco co-working space for meetings and team events.

Responsibilities

  • Ship product. Use AI-assisted prototyping and an internal coding agent called Roomote to move ideas from concept to production faster than the traditional PM-to-eng handoff allows.
  • Contribute to roadmap and prioritization with guidance, developing your instinct for what will drive the most impact toward the squad's north star metric.
  • Collaborate with engineering, design, operations, and marketing to define and deliver solutions—knowing when a problem requires the full team and when you can move independently to get something across the finish line yourself.
  • Write clear, decision-ready PRDs. AI can accelerate your drafting—but the hard thinking is yours: deeply understanding the problem, interrogating the tradeoffs, and arriving at a solution that genuinely serves users and the business.
  • Use data to stay honest. Run your own analyses with the help of AI, maintain fluency in dashboards, and flag when a question needs deeper support.
  • Adopt an experimentation mindset, finding ways to quickly test and iterate on hypotheses.
  • Run your own research with guidance. Use AI tools to synthesize market signals, competitive intelligence, and user feedback quickly—so you're always operating from insight, not assumption.
  • Help maintain a healthy, fast-moving product development process within the squad through clear communication and tight documentation.

Qualifications

  • 2-3 years of product management experience, or equivalent experience where you were driving product decisions and building product features in a different capacity (e.g. engineering)
  • Strong user empathy and a customer-first mindset—you're genuinely curious about the people you're building for.
  • Clear communicator: you can explain what you're building and why to teammates across functions and levels.
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in your workflow—for research, writing, analysis, prototyping, or shipping. (This is not a nice-to-have.)
  • Comfortable using data (quantitative and qualitative) to inform decisions and track progress, with a willingness to get hands-on in dashboards and do your own analysis.
  • Eager to learn in ambiguity, with a bias toward action and a track record of following through on commitments.
  • Collaborative and low-ego; you know how to earn trust with engineering, design, and ops and can influence without authority.
  • Cares deeply about UX and can articulate product improvements clearly, whether in writing, mockups, or conversation.
  • Bonus: Experience in labor marketplaces, healthcare tech, or an early-stage startup. Experience using AI coding tools (Cursor, Replit, v0, etc.) to build working prototypes or ship production features.

While we are a remote first company, if you are based in San Francisco this will be a hybrid role.

Idaho Rural Healthcare Finance and Revenue Cycle Leadership Opportunities

Rural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Idaho to identify experienced finance and revenue cycle leaders who understand the unique realities of rural healthcare.

We are currently connecting with professionals who may be interested in active and upcoming finance, accounting, reimbursement, revenue cycle, billing, coding, and patient financial services leadership opportunities across Idaho.

These opportunities may include leadership within Critical Access Hospitals, rural and community hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, public hospital districts, long-term care organizations, and integrated rural healthcare systems.

This Is More Than a Finance Role

Strong financial and revenue cycle operations help protect healthcare access for an entire rural community.

These leaders ensure organizations can accurately capture revenue, manage resources responsibly, support employees, maintain compliance, and remain financially strong enough to continue caring for the people who depend on them.

In a rural healthcare organization, finance and revenue cycle leaders often work across departments and may have broader responsibilities than they would in a larger system. The strongest leaders understand how registration, coding, billing, reimbursement, patient accounts, accounting, and operational decisions connect to one another.

They are collaborative, detail-oriented, approachable, and able to turn complex financial information into practical guidance for employees, department leaders, executives, and governing boards.

Opportunities May Include

This application may connect you with current or upcoming roles such as:

  • Controller
  • Assistant Controller
  • Finance Director or Manager
  • Accounting Director or Manager
  • Revenue Cycle Director or Manager
  • Patient Financial Services Director or Manager
  • Patient Accounts Manager
  • Business Office Director or Manager
  • Billing Director or Manager
  • Coding Director, Manager, or Supervisor
  • Health Information Management revenue cycle leadership
  • Reimbursement Director or Manager
  • Chargemaster or Charge Description Master leadership
  • Accounts Payable or Accounts Receivable leadership
  • Payroll leadership
  • Senior billing, coding, or patient accounts supervisory roles

What You May Lead

Responsibilities will vary by organization and position and may include:

  • Leading accounting, finance, revenue cycle, billing, coding, or patient financial services functions
  • Supporting accurate and timely financial reporting
  • Managing month-end and year-end close processes
  • Developing budgets, forecasts, and financial performance reports
  • Strengthening billing, collections, cash flow, and reimbursement performance
  • Monitoring key revenue cycle metrics and identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Supporting accurate coding, charge capture, claims submission, and payment posting
  • Overseeing patient accounts, financial counseling, and collection processes
  • Ensuring compliance with payer, regulatory, accounting, and documentation requirements
  • Preparing for financial, coding, billing, or compliance audits
  • Developing policies, procedures, workflows, and internal controls
  • Training and supporting finance and revenue cycle employees
  • Collaborating with clinical, operational, IT, HIM, and executive leaders
  • Helping employees understand how their work affects organizational sustainability
  • Supporting system implementations, process improvements, or departmental restructuring

What You Will Bring

Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

  • Progressive experience in healthcare finance, accounting, revenue cycle, billing, coding, reimbursement, or patient financial services
  • Previous leadership experience as a director, manager, controller, supervisor, or comparable leader
  • Knowledge of healthcare reimbursement, payer requirements, billing practices, and financial operations
  • Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, and patient-pay accounts
  • An understanding of hospital, clinic, or healthcare-system workflows
  • Experience analyzing financial or revenue cycle performance and communicating findings to leadership
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and team-development skills
  • Experience with Critical Access Hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, FQHCs, public hospital districts, or community healthcare organizations
  • Relevant education or professional credentials based on the position
  • A collaborative and relationship-focused leadership style

Some opportunities may prefer credentials such as CPA, CHFP, CRCR, CPC, CCS, RHIA, RHIT, or other finance, coding, revenue cycle, or health information certifications. Requirements will depend on the specific role.

Why Rural Idaho?

Idaho's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, forests, farmland, rivers, lakes, and wide open spaces. These organizations frequently operate with lean teams, limited resources, and a tremendous responsibility to the communities they serve.

Finance and revenue cycle leadership in a rural organization provides the opportunity to see the direct impact of your work. Improving a process, supporting a team, or strengthening reimbursement can help preserve services, protect jobs, and keep care available close to home.

Join the RSS Rural Talent Network

By applying through this page, you are joining the confidential Rural Staffing Services talent network. You may be considered for current or upcoming finance and revenue cycle leadership opportunities that align with your background, goals, location preferences, and availability.

Please include your resume and let us know:

  • Which Idaho communities or regions you would consider
  • Whether you are open to relocation
  • Whether you are interested in permanent, interim, remote, fractional, or multiple types of opportunities
  • Which areas best match your experience, such as accounting, finance, billing, coding, reimbursement, patient accounts, or full revenue cycle
  • Your experience with rural hospitals, Critical Access Hospitals, public hospital districts, FQHCs, or community healthcare organizations
  • Which position or community you were viewing on RSSJobs.org

Our team personally reviews each application. When we identify an opportunity that may be a strong match, we will contact you directly to share more about the organization, community, responsibilities, and next steps.

Your information will be handled professionally and confidentially.

Work Where It Matters.

PartsBase offers a FULLY remote environment where one can work at the forefront of where the aviation business meets technology. Imagine getting to work with peers worldwide, implementing business technology projects that challenge the boundaries.

Life at PartsBase:

One of the top benefits of working at PartsBase is the culture. We are a TEAM-focused organization, and everyone celebrates each other's successes. Our inclusive culture welcomes all employees and values their unique contributions to our success. Our clients tell us time and time again that our people set us apart from the competition. The Opportunity

We are hiring a Director of Revenue Operations role to build and own the RevOps function from the ground up. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position for a senior operator who thrives on bringing order to complexity, building systems that scale, and turning data into decisions.

Today, RevOps works with forecasting, pipeline hygiene, GTM systems, process design, and analytics & is distributed across teams without a dedicated owner. You will change that. Forecasting & Pipeline Management

Systems & Data Infrastructure

Process & GTM Workflow

Reporting & Analytics

Planning & Enablement Support

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • Forecast accuracy within +10% of actuals by end of year.
  • A single, trusted source of truth for pipeline and revenue data adopted by all GTM teams.

  • A RevOps roadmap endorsed by GTM leadership and actively in motion.
