jobs.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a proactive and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote UGC Program Manager, Social & Performance Creative opening.
jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a proactive and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote UGC Program Manager, Social & Performance Creative opening.

As the UGC Program Manager, Social & Performance Creative, you will build and scale the company's UGC and social media systems to support aggressive DTC growth goals. You will oversee the sourcing, coordination, and execution of UGC and video creatives for paid and organic channels, while helping strengthen the company's online presence, customer trust, and conversion performance across key touchpoints. You will contribute directly to the company's growth by ensuring a constant pipeline of high-quality creative assets, managing social media execution, and creating scalable processes and SOPs that allow the system to grow efficiently over time.

About the company:
The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.
Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Build & Scale UGC and Video Creative Production Pipeline

  • Build and manage a consistent UGC sourcing and production pipeline for paid ads, website assets, and social media content.
  • Coordinate creators, briefs, scripts, references, and deliverables to ensure a steady flow of high-quality video and photo assets.
  • Manage and organize creative assets, ensuring files are properly stored, categorized, and accessible for the marketing and DTC teams.
  • Collaborate with the DTC and creative teams to iterate on top-performing creatives and continuously improve performance.
  • Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines, customer positioning, and conversion goals.

Execute Social Media Content & Community Growth

  • Manage and grow the company's Facebook and Instagram presence through consistent posting and content execution.
  • Coordinate and publish organic social media content, including reels, posts, stories, and UGC-based assets.
  • Help strengthen customer trust and brand positioning through clear, engaging, and customer-focused content.
  • Monitor content performance and audience engagement, identifying opportunities for improvement and optimization.

Support Paid Social & Performance Creative

  • Collaborate with the DTC and paid media teams to develop UGC and social creatives optimized for Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ads.
  • Coordinate production and delivery of creatives that support ad testing, scaling, and conversion optimization efforts.
  • Assist in identifying winning creative angles, hooks, and content formats based on performance insights and feedback.

Create SOPs & Scalable Processes

  • Build and document clear SOPs and workflows for UGC sourcing, creator management, content production, asset organization, and publishing processes.
  • Help establish scalable systems that support long-term creative production and social media growth.
  • Continuously improve internal processes to increase efficiency, consistency, and execution quality.

Qualifications:

  • 1+ year of experience managing or coordinating UGC and video creative production for ads, social media, or eCommerce brands.
  • Preferred 1+ year of experience managing organic social media content and execution for Facebook and Instagram.
  • Preferred 1+ year of experience working with Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ad creatives and performance-focused content.
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of experience with additional paid or organic platforms such as TikTok or YouTube.
  • Experience coordinating creators, content production, or creative workflows in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Drive, Notion, Airtable, CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple moving parts, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changing priorities and conditions. Copes effectively with complexity and change.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: plans, organizes, schedules, and prioritizes work in an efficient and productive manner.
  • Enthusiasm: exhibits passion and excitement over work. Has a can-do attitude.
  • Creativity / Innovation: generates new and innovative approaches to problems and creative execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through UGC systems, social media execution, and performance creative support.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organized and proactive professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, enjoys building systems and coordinating creative execution, and is motivated by performance, continuous improvement, and long-term growth.

Clinical Care and Psychological Assessments

Workplace Mental Health and Psychosocial Risk

Stakeholder partnership and Clinical Account Support

Crisis and Critical Incident Support

Research and Evidence Generation

  • Contribute to Intellect's research and evaluation efforts in Australia, including partnerships with universities and applied workplace mental health studies
  • Support clinically grounded data collection, interpretation, and programme improvement initiatives
  • Help strengthen Intellect's evidence base and thought leadership in workplace mental health and psychosocial safety

      • Experience in psychosocial risk assessment or workplace mental health programmes is highly regarded
      • Strong clinical judgement and communication skills
      • Comfortable working across individual care, organisational contexts, and stakeholder engagement

Benefits

Benefits

Our client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Inventory & Logistics Specialist to oversee end-to-end supply chain and inventory operations. This full-time remote role combines freight management, Amazon FBA coordination, inventory forecasting, and reverse logistics to ensure smooth operations across all sales channels. If you are experienced in e-commerce logistics, Amazon fulfillment, and supply chain optimization, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, high-impact environment, wed love to hear from you.

About the company:

The company is a premium pet brand known for its high-quality, durable bulky pet products and accessories. Built for both professionals and devoted pet owners, the brands products are designed with attention to detail, functionality, and longevity. The brand is committed to creating elevated, practical experiences for pets and their people—and is looking for an Inventory & Logistics Specialist to help scale that mission by ensuring seamless product flow from factory to customer.

Key Responsibilities:

Freight & Supply Chain Management

  • Manage end-to-end order placement with factories and track order progress through to completion.
  • Request, negotiate, and select the best quotes from freight forwarders, determining the optimal type of sea freight for each specific situation.
  • Design ideal loading configurations for shipping containers based on product dimensions to maximize space and reduce shipping costs.
  • Oversee the loading process through active communication with factories and freight partners.
  • Track all global shipments, proactively flagging and mitigating any potential delays.

Amazon FBA & E-commerce Operations

  • Create and manage Amazon Shipments, utilizing software solutions (e.g., 9Yards and similar simulation tools) to run multiple simulations and target the most cost-effective Amazon warehouses.
  • Oversee the receiving of units at both Amazon fulfillment centers and partner 3PL warehouses.
  • Perform thorough reconciliation for all inbound shipments to ensure accurate stock levels and file claims for missing units when necessary.
  • Coordinate Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) orders for Last Mile transport from our 3PL to customers for non-Amazon (DTC/B2B) orders.

Inventory Forecasting & Management

  • Continuously monitor inventory levels across all sales channels to prevent overstocking or Out-of-Stock (OOS) situations.
  • Forecast inventory movements and project OOS dates at the SKU level to accurately plan factory order quantities.

Reverse Logistics & Returns Management

  • Create and manage Amazon removal orders for customer returns.
  • Arrange transport from Amazon to 3PL/processing facilities.
  • Oversee the de-kitting, inspection, and sorting of damaged units into tiers for parts harvesting or resale.

Scale of Operations:

  • Container Shipments: ~8 per month.
  • LTL Orders (Last Mile): ~10 per week.
  • Factory Orders: ~6 per year.

Software & Workflow Proficiency:

  • Amazon FBA & E-commerce Systems: Deep expertise with Amazon Seller Central, FBA placement optimization, inbound reconciliation, and removal/disposal orders.
  • Forecasting & Inventory Management: Hands-on experience with IMS tools (SoStocked, RestockPro, Cin7, Skubana), advanced Excel or Google Sheets for SKU-level forecasting and run-rate models.
  • Logistics, Freight & 3PL Integration: Familiarity with container load planning software (EasyCargo, CubeMaster), freight platforms (Flexport, Freightos), warehouse management systems (ShipStation, ShipHero), and reverse logistics workflows.

Core Competencies

  • 3+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or Amazon inventory management.
  • Proven ability to manage complex shipments and multi-stage fulfillment workflows across international markets.
  • Strong understanding of Amazon FBA processes and multi-channel e-commerce operations.
  • Advanced analytical mindset with the ability to build and interpret detailed SKU-level forecasting and inventory models.
  • Practical experience coordinating international freight, container shipments, and 3PL operations in a multi-channel environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and high attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
  • Alignment with the companys premium brand standards and operational excellence mindset.

Why Join Us:

  • Play a critical role in ensuring smooth operations for a high-ticket pet brand on Amazon.
  • Own inventory planning, logistics, and fulfillment workflows.
  • Work remotely from anywhere.
  • Competitive salary and flexible working hours.
  • Collaborate with a creative, forward-thinking team dedicated to innovation in the pet space.
  • Make a tangible impact on a brand that values quality, customer experience, and operational excellence.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer
jobs.excerpt: Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche.
jobs.description:
Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche. They are seeking a highly experienced professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer opening.

As the Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer, you will lead the design and development of next-generation patient care products - from concept through production - translating caregiver feedback, customer reviews, and competitive insights into profitable, manufacturable solutions with exceptional ergonomics, usability, and functional detail.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to enhancing the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. Customer obsession is a guiding principle that shapes the company's strategy, culture, and decisions.

The company's mission is centered on improving well-being through meticulous attention to detail and continuous listening to customer feedback, ensuring that its solutions meet real caregiving needs. Its vision is to empower patients and caregivers with innovative products that improve quality of life. The company also values caring customer service, professional growth, work-life balance, and a supportive environment where team members can thrive and contribute to meaningful product impact.

This is a Full-Time | Fully Remote position reporting to the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from concept development to production-ready solutions, ensuring all designs go through rigorous DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) analysis.
  • Translate internal product briefs, caregiver feedback, VOC data, and customer reviews into innovative, user-centered product concepts.
  • Apply deep materials knowledge to select the most suitable materials that balance aesthetic with structural durability and cost-efficiency.
  • Create advanced CAD models and detailed technical design and engineering documentation, utilizing FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and structural simulations to validate mechanical integrity and performance before prototyping.
  • Design and validate mockups, prototypes, and functional test samples.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, sourcing partners, and marketing to balance creativity with cost targets, supplier capabilities, and timelines.
  • Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.
  • Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).
  • Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

  • Deliver 4–6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.
  • Develop final production-ready samples of 12–18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.
  • Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.
  • Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.
  • Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.
  • Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.
    • 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.
    • Experience taking products from concept to mass production.
    • Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.
    • Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.
    • Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.
    • Experience designing products for marketplaces influenced by public customer reviews.
    • Experience with mechanical CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Onshape.
    • Experience with cost modeling and margin-focused design decisions.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements.
    • Deep understanding of ergonomics, usability, and user-centered design principles.
    • Close attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
    • Proactive problem-solver with a strong ownership mindset.
    • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
    • High adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-scaling environment.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to Detail – Nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Commitment & Work Ethic – Willingness to go the distance to get results.
  • Consistency & Persistence – Demonstrates tenacity in achieving goals.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset – Sees and communicates the bigger picture.
  • Proactive Problem Solving – Brings new ideas without being prompted.
  • Integrity & Trustworthiness – Operates with honesty and transparency.
  • Customer Obsession – Actively integrates customer feedback into product improvements.
  • Creativity & Innovation – Develops original, differentiated solutions.
  • High Standards – Expects excellence from self and team.
  • Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration – Works seamlessly across departments.
  • Analytical Thinking – Transforms data into informed design decisions.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic and evolving conditions.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Opportunity to design next-generation patient care products with meaningful market impact.
  • Direct influence on revenue growth and product innovation strategy.
  • High ownership and autonomy in decision-making.
  • A performance-driven, values-based culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored Company Trips.
  • Quarterly Rock Bonus.
  • Performance Bonus.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is a unique opportunity for a senior-level designer who combines creativity with engineering discipline, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer empathy with commercial awareness.

jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a proactive and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote UGC Program Manager, Social & Performance Creative opening.

As the UGC Program Manager, Social & Performance Creative, you will build and scale the company's UGC and social media systems to support aggressive DTC growth goals. You will oversee the sourcing, coordination, and execution of UGC and video creatives for paid and organic channels, while helping strengthen the company's online presence, customer trust, and conversion performance across key touchpoints. You will contribute directly to the company's growth by ensuring a constant pipeline of high-quality creative assets, managing social media execution, and creating scalable processes and SOPs that allow the system to grow efficiently over time.

About the company:
The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.
Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Build & Scale UGC and Video Creative Production Pipeline

  • Build and manage a consistent UGC sourcing and production pipeline for paid ads, website assets, and social media content.
  • Coordinate creators, briefs, scripts, references, and deliverables to ensure a steady flow of high-quality video and photo assets.
  • Manage and organize creative assets, ensuring files are properly stored, categorized, and accessible for the marketing and DTC teams.
  • Collaborate with the DTC and creative teams to iterate on top-performing creatives and continuously improve performance.
  • Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines, customer positioning, and conversion goals.

Execute Social Media Content & Community Growth

  • Manage and grow the company's Facebook and Instagram presence through consistent posting and content execution.
  • Coordinate and publish organic social media content, including reels, posts, stories, and UGC-based assets.
  • Help strengthen customer trust and brand positioning through clear, engaging, and customer-focused content.
  • Monitor content performance and audience engagement, identifying opportunities for improvement and optimization.

Support Paid Social & Performance Creative

  • Collaborate with the DTC and paid media teams to develop UGC and social creatives optimized for Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ads.
  • Coordinate production and delivery of creatives that support ad testing, scaling, and conversion optimization efforts.
  • Assist in identifying winning creative angles, hooks, and content formats based on performance insights and feedback.

Create SOPs & Scalable Processes

  • Build and document clear SOPs and workflows for UGC sourcing, creator management, content production, asset organization, and publishing processes.
  • Help establish scalable systems that support long-term creative production and social media growth.
  • Continuously improve internal processes to increase efficiency, consistency, and execution quality.

Qualifications:

  • 1+ year of experience managing or coordinating UGC and video creative production for ads, social media, or eCommerce brands.
  • Preferred 1+ year of experience managing organic social media content and execution for Facebook and Instagram.
  • Preferred 1+ year of experience working with Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ad creatives and performance-focused content.
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of experience with additional paid or organic platforms such as TikTok or YouTube.
  • Experience coordinating creators, content production, or creative workflows in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Drive, Notion, Airtable, CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple moving parts, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changing priorities and conditions. Copes effectively with complexity and change.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: plans, organizes, schedules, and prioritizes work in an efficient and productive manner.
  • Enthusiasm: exhibits passion and excitement over work. Has a can-do attitude.
  • Creativity / Innovation: generates new and innovative approaches to problems and creative execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through UGC systems, social media execution, and performance creative support.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organized and proactive professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, enjoys building systems and coordinating creative execution, and is motivated by performance, continuous improvement, and long-term growth.

jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company operating in the USA, is looking for a talented and proactive HR Specialist to join its team in a full-time remote position.

As an HR Specialist, you will play an important role in supporting the company's growth by attracting top talent, managing recruitment processes, and contributing to various HR and People Operations initiatives. You will work closely with hiring managers and team members to help build a high-performing, engaged, and people-focused organization.

If you are passionate about both recruitment and HR, enjoy working with people, and thrive in a dynamic remote environment, we would love to hear from you.

About the Company

The company is a fast-growing eCommerce business focused on creating high-quality consumer products for customers around the world. Built on a foundation of innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, the company continues to expand across global marketplaces while maintaining a strong commitment to operational excellence and long-term brand growth.

The company values initiative, ownership, and collaboration, and is looking for team members who are excited to contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full-cycle recruitment process, from sourcing and screening candidates to coordinating interviews and supporting hiring decisions.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and develop effective recruitment strategies.
  • Source and engage qualified candidates through various channels, including LinkedIn, job boards, professional networks, and direct outreach.
  • Ensure a positive and professional candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding processes.
  • Maintain employee records, HR documentation, and internal HR processes.
  • Assist with employee engagement initiatives, internal communications, and team-building activities.
  • Support the development and implementation of HR policies, procedures, and best practices.
  • Assist with performance review processes and employee feedback initiatives.
  • Monitor employee satisfaction and help foster a positive and collaborative company culture.
  • Track recruitment and HR metrics, providing regular reports and insights.
  • Support various People Operations projects as the company continues to grow.
  • Develop and support employer branding initiatives to strengthen the company's presence as an employer of choice.
  • Collaborate with leadership and team members to showcase company culture, values, and employee experience across recruitment channels.
  • Create and maintain engaging candidate-facing content, including job descriptions, recruitment campaigns, and employer branding materials.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in recruitment, Human Resources, People Operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience managing full-cycle recruitment processes across different types of roles.
  • Strong sourcing and candidate outreach skills.
  • Good understanding of HR processes and the employee lifecycle.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Understanding of employer branding and talent attraction best practices.
  • Experience supporting employer branding, recruitment marketing, or employee engagement initiatives is highly preferred.
  • Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, HR systems, and modern recruitment tools is highly preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships across teams.
  • Experience working in a remote and international environment is a plus.
  • Experience supporting eCommerce, operations, marketing, or digital teams is preferred.

What We Offer

  • Work for a market-proven, fast-growing company.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment.
  • Opportunity to play a key role in building and developing a high-performing team.
  • High level of autonomy and ownership in your role.
  • Fully remote work and flexible working hours.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to enhancing the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. Customer obsession is a guiding principle that shapes the company's strategy, culture, and decisions.

The company's mission is centered on improving well-being through meticulous attention to detail and continuous listening to customer feedback, ensuring that its solutions meet real caregiving needs. Its vision is to empower patients and caregivers with innovative products that improve quality of life. The company also values caring customer service, professional growth, work-life balance, and a supportive environment where team members can thrive and contribute to meaningful product impact.

This is a Full-Time | Fully Remote position reporting to the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from concept development to production-ready solutions, ensuring all designs go through rigorous DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) analysis.
  • Translate internal product briefs, caregiver feedback, VOC data, and customer reviews into innovative, user-centered product concepts.
  • Apply deep materials knowledge to select the most suitable materials that balance aesthetic with structural durability and cost-efficiency.
  • Create advanced CAD models and detailed technical design and engineering documentation, utilizing FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and structural simulations to validate mechanical integrity and performance before prototyping.
  • Design and validate mockups, prototypes, and functional test samples.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, sourcing partners, and marketing to balance creativity with cost targets, supplier capabilities, and timelines.
  • Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.
  • Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).
  • Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

  • Deliver 4–6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.
  • Develop final production-ready samples of 12–18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.
  • Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.
  • Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.
  • Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.
  • Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.
    • 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.
    • Experience taking products from concept to mass production.
    • Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.
    • Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.
    • Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.
    • Experience designing products for marketplaces influenced by public customer reviews.
    • Experience with mechanical CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Onshape.
    • Experience with cost modeling and margin-focused design decisions.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements.
    • Deep understanding of ergonomics, usability, and user-centered design principles.
    • Close attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
    • Proactive problem-solver with a strong ownership mindset.
    • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
    • High adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-scaling environment.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to Detail – Nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Commitment & Work Ethic – Willingness to go the distance to get results.
  • Consistency & Persistence – Demonstrates tenacity in achieving goals.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset – Sees and communicates the bigger picture.
  • Proactive Problem Solving – Brings new ideas without being prompted.
  • Integrity & Trustworthiness – Operates with honesty and transparency.
  • Customer Obsession – Actively integrates customer feedback into product improvements.
  • Creativity & Innovation – Develops original, differentiated solutions.
  • High Standards – Expects excellence from self and team.
  • Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration – Works seamlessly across departments.
  • Analytical Thinking – Transforms data into informed design decisions.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic and evolving conditions.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunity to design next-generation patient care products with meaningful market impact.
  • Direct influence on revenue growth and product innovation strategy.
  • High ownership and autonomy in decision-making.
  • A performance-driven, values-based culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored Company Trips.
  • Quarterly Rock Bonus.
  • Performance Bonus.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is a unique opportunity for a senior-level designer who combines creativity with engineering discipline, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer empathy with commercial awareness.

You will oversee the sourcing, coordination, and execution of UGC and video creatives for paid and organic channels, while helping strengthen the company's online presence, customer trust, and conversion performance across key touchpoints. The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Build & Scale UGC and Video Creative Production Pipeline

  • Build and manage a consistent UGC sourcing and production pipeline for paid ads, website assets, and social media content.
  • Coordinate creators, briefs, scripts, references, and deliverables to ensure a steady flow of high-quality video and photo assets.
  • Manage and organize creative assets, ensuring files are properly stored, categorized, and accessible for the marketing and DTC teams.
  • Collaborate with the DTC and creative teams to iterate on top-performing creatives and continuously improve performance.
  • Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines, customer positioning, and conversion goals.

Execute Social Media Content & Community Growth

  • Manage and grow the company's Facebook and Instagram presence through consistent posting and content execution.
  • Coordinate and publish organic social media content, including reels, posts, stories, and UGC-based assets.
  • Help strengthen customer trust and brand positioning through clear, engaging, and customer-focused content.
  • Monitor content performance and audience engagement, identifying opportunities for improvement and optimization.

Support Paid Social & Performance Creative

  • Collaborate with the DTC and paid media teams to develop UGC and social creatives optimized for Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ads.
  • Coordinate production and delivery of creatives that support ad testing, scaling, and conversion optimization efforts.
  • Assist in identifying winning creative angles, hooks, and content formats based on performance insights and feedback.

Create SOPs & Scalable Processes

  • Build and document clear SOPs and workflows for UGC sourcing, creator management, content production, asset organization, and publishing processes.
  • Help establish scalable systems that support long-term creative production and social media growth.
  • Continuously improve internal processes to increase efficiency, consistency, and execution quality.

Qualifications:

  • 1+ year of experience managing or coordinating UGC and video creative production for ads, social media, or eCommerce brands.
  • Preferred 1+ year of experience managing organic social media content and execution for Facebook and Instagram.
  • Preferred 1+ year of experience working with Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ad creatives and performance-focused content.
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of experience with additional paid or organic platforms such as TikTok or YouTube.
  • Experience coordinating creators, content production, or creative workflows in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Drive, Notion, Airtable, CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple moving parts, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.

  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changing priorities and conditions. Copes effectively with complexity and change.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: plans, organizes, schedules, and prioritizes work in an efficient and productive manner.
  • Enthusiasm: exhibits passion and excitement over work. Has a can-do attitude.
  • Creativity / Innovation: generates new and innovative approaches to problems and creative execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through UGC systems, social media execution, and performance creative support.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.

  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

jobs.excerpt: About RightMoveRightMove is redefining how musculoskeletal (MSK) care is delivered – shifting from fragmented, volume-driven care to a new operating system for how people move and thrive.
jobs.description:
About RightMove

RightMove is redefining how musculoskeletal (MSK) care is delivered – shifting from fragmented, volume-driven care to a new operating system for how people move and thrive.

Backed by leading investors in value-based care and AI—including Flare Capital Partners, Frist Cressey Ventures and Greycroft—and built in partnership with the Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS), the world leader in MSK health trusted by elite athletes, we are creating a new standard of coordinated, expert-led care that gets people moving better and faster.

Our platform combines clinician-led triage with a purpose-built technology and data infrastructure—trained on tens of thousands of real clinical decisions and grounded in HSS protocols—to guide patients to the right care, at the right time, with the right provider. We are building an AI- and analytics-driven system that continuously improves clinical decision-making, patient engagement, and outcomes at scale. RightMove’s care model integrates patient engagement, clinical care from PTs and APPs under orthopedic physician oversight, virtual physical therapy, and navigation across a high-value provider network.

We are rapidly expanding across markets nationwide with leading employers and health plans, building the infrastructure for value-based MSK care at scale.

Our Mission & Values

We’re a high-performing team driven by one mission: to free people to move and thrive. At RightMove, we move fast, collaborate deeply, and deliver with precision. We’re a startup with enterprise-grade rigor—where talented operators, clinicians and engineers challenge conventions to improve patient outcomes.

We live our values every day:

  • Perform to Win – We bring our best to deliver measurable results, valuing impact over optics.
  • Be Direct with Respect – We communicate clearly, with honesty and care.
  • Move as One Team – We win together, across roles and functions.
  • Act with Agency – Our teams have high trust and high accountability, with the freedom to own and responsibility to deliver.
  • Choose Optimism – We bring energy and perspective, even when the work is hard.

What You’ll Do

This is a senior leadership role on RightMove’s Growth team, responsible for expanding our payer, employer, and strategic partner relationships.

As Vice President, Commercial Partnerships, you will own the strategy and execution required to convert RightMove’s clinical model, HSS partnership, AI-enabled platform, and value-based economics into scalable commercial partnerships.

You will build and manage a high-quality pipeline across Commercial and Medicare Advantage health plans, self-insured employers, benefits platforms, consultants, TPAs, and strategic ecosystem partners. You will lead complex enterprise sales cycles, shape partnership structures, and help define how RightMove goes to market across payer, employer, and channel segments.

This role owns one of the most important questions in RightMove’s growth: how we translate a differentiated care model into repeatable, scalable demand across the buyers responsible for MSK cost, access, outcomes, and member experience.

What You’ll Own

Payer & Employer Growth Strategy

  • Partner with leadership to determine which buyer segments, geographies, and partnership models should receive near-term focus across health plans, employers, TPAs, benefits platforms, consultants, and channel partners
  • Define and execute RightMove’s commercial strategy across target segments and prioritize target accounts based on market readiness, covered lives, strategic value, savings opportunity, and implementation feasibility
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline across prioritized segments and markets

Enterprise Sales & Partnership Development

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from initial relationship through contracting and launch
  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives across health plans, employers, consultants, and strategic partners
  • Translate RightMove’s clinical, operational, network, and technology capabilities into buyer-specific value propositions
  • Own RFPs, finalist presentations, executive meetings, and commercial negotiation strategy
  • Create referenceable partnerships that support future market expansion

Commercial Model & Contract Strategy

  • Structure partnership models that align buyer economics with RightMove’s value-based care model
  • Support development of pricing models including PMPM, case rate, FFS, shared savings, and risk-based commercial arrangements
  • Partner with Finance and Clinical leadership to translate savings assumptions into credible buyer-facing ROI models
  • Collaborate with Financial, Operations and Partners Success to define guardrails for decision making around pricing, performance guarantees, implementation terms, data requirements, and success metrics
  • Ensure commercial commitments are achievable operationally and supportable financially

Market & Buyer Intelligence

  • Develop deep understanding of buyer needs across payer, employer, and channel segments
  • Track competitive dynamics across digital MSK, specialty care, navigation, UM, and value-based care models
  • Identify where RightMove’s model is most differentiated based on buyer pain points, population needs, network dynamics, and willingness to adopt value-based solutions
  • Feed buyer insights back into product, clinical, network, implementation, and analytics strategy

Cross-Functional Growth Leadership

  • Partner closely with Network Strategy, Clinical, Product, Finance, Partner Success and Operations to ensure sold deals can be implemented successfully
  • Support development of a cross-function process to stage gate and qualify partnerships in alignment with key stakeholders including finance, operations and customer success.
  • Help shape market launch priorities based on commercial demand and network readiness
  • Support executive-level partner management for strategic accounts
  • Build scalable sales materials, pitch narratives, ROI models, and contracting playbooks
  • Contribute to the development of RightMove’s overall growth function as the company scales

What Success Looks Like

  1. Pipeline Creation: Build and maintain a qualified pipeline across payer, employer, and channel partners aligned with RightMove’s strategic markets
  2. Revenue Conversion: Convert priority accounts into signed contracts with clear covered lives, economics, launch timelines, and performance metrics
  3. Strategic Fit: Prioritize opportunities that strengthen market density, network leverage, and long-term value creation
  4. Commercial Repeatability: Develop a scalable sales and partnership playbook across payer, employer, and channel segments
  5. Economic Discipline: Structure deals that support RightMove’s margin, savings, and implementation requirements
  6. Referenceability: Create high-quality buyer relationships that become referenceable proof points for future growth

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in healthcare business development, enterprise sales, payer/employer partnerships, benefits, healthcare services, or value-based care
  • Demonstrated success selling complex healthcare solutions to health plans, employers, consultants, TPAs, or benefits platforms
  • Experience navigating long, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles
  • Strong understanding of payer/employer economics, healthcare cost trend, claims-based ROI models, and value-based care arrangements
  • Ability to translate clinical, operational, and financial concepts into compelling commercial narratives
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Finance, or related field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling into national or regional health plans, self-insured employers, consultants, or benefits platforms
  • Familiarity with MSK, specialty care, navigation, digital health, virtual care, or risk-bearing care models
  • Track record structuring PMPM, case rate, shared savings, risk-based, or performance-guaranteed contracts
  • Experience with RFPs, consultant-led procurement processes, and enterprise finalist presentations
  • Strong understanding of claims analysis, population health analytics, and employer/payer ROI expectations
  • Existing relationships across payer, employer, consultant, benefits, or healthcare services ecosystems

About You

  • Strategic seller, not just a relationship manager
  • Understand how payers and employers make decisions
  • Can sell a vision while staying grounded in economics, operations, and proof
  • Credible with senior buyers, consultants, clinical leaders, and finance teams
  • Can move from boardroom narrative to contract detail without losing momentum
  • Can operate in ambiguity and building the commercial playbook as the company scales
  • Direct, resilient, highly organized, and commercially disciplined
  • Can align internal teams around what must be true to win and deliver
  • Ability to travel as needed for partner meetings, conferences and team collaboration

You love teaching English. You're good at it. But somewhere between the back-to-back group classes, the unpredictable schedules, and the lack of real student connection, it stopped feeling like teaching and started feeling like crowd management.

What if you could teach one student at a time — someone who actually booked you, actually shows up, and actually wants to learn?

Here Is Your Solution

The Really Great Teacher Company is looking for a passionate, professional ESL teacher from the Philippines to deliver one-on-one conversational and assessment-based English lessons to adult Japanese students. This is a structured, fully remote role with a real platform behind it — and students who choose to come back to you.

Position Details

  • Start Date: As soon as the recruitment process is concluded
  • Location: Remote - work-from-home
  • Students: Adult Japanese learners (all proficiency levels, beginner to advanced)
  • Format: One-on-one, 25-minute conversational and assessment-based classes
  • Language of Instruction: English
  • Rate: $3.85 USD per hour
  • Contract Type: Independent contractor agreement with The Really Great Teacher Company
  • Schedule: Assigned shift; 5-minute break between consecutive classes
  • Additional Classes: Option to cover classes for absent teachers
  • Student Booking: Students book one class at a time; regular students possible if they enjoy your teaching

Requirements

  • 3-year National Diploma (minimum qualification)
  • Completed, accredited 120-hour TEFL certificate or equivalent
  • Minimum 1 year of ESL teaching experience
  • Demo lesson required as part of the application process
  • Able to teach English across all CEFR proficiency levels — from absolute beginner to advanced
  • Energetic, student-focused, and comfortable teaching online
  • Schedule-aware and responsive: you are responsible for knowing your shift and adapting to changes

Skills & Personal Attributes

  • Clear and effective communication
  • Patience and empathy with learners at all levels
  • Positive attitude and professional presence
  • Strong time management and organisational skills
  • Adaptability in a dynamic, student-driven environment
  • Problem-solving mindset

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Processor minimum 2GHz / 4 CPU; RAM minimum 8GB
  • Internet: Fibre connection with LAN cable; minimum 20 Mbps upload and download speed
  • Backup power: Required (load shedding/power outage preparedness)
  • Webcam and noise-cancelling headset
  • Quiet, private, well-lit teaching space with a neutral background

For more information, view our online ESL teacher's tech checklist.

Benefits

  1. Earn in USD: Your rate is $3.85 USD per hour — paid in a stable international currency, straight to you as an independent contractor.
  2. Real One-on-One Teaching: No group classes. Every session is 25 minutes with a single adult student. You'll adapt to their level — from absolute beginner to very advanced — and actually see the impact of your teaching.
  3. Teach Into a Market That Values Education: Japanese adult learners are motivated, respectful, and genuinely invested in improving their English. If they like you, they come back — meaning you can build a loyal, consistent student base over time.
  4. Minimal Admin — No Report Writing Required: The client uses AI to generate detailed student reports. Your only contribution is a brief, encouraging message — around 2 minutes of your time per class. That's it.
  5. Everything You Need Is Provided: Lesson materials are fully provided. You teach on the client's internal platform (linked to Zoom) — no lesson planning from scratch, no hunting for resources.
  6. Free Professional Development via Inspire Academy: As a teacher with The Really Great Teacher Company, you get access to Inspire Academy — our free professional development platform designed to help you grow as an online educator.
  7. Onboarding Support & Community: You won't be thrown in the deep end. Structured onboarding and dedicated support are available, along with a community of fellow teachers via the Evolve Program.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer Core Team (GoLang + PHP)
jobs.excerpt: Про нас: BetterMe — глобальна wellness-екосистема, що створює продукти для фізичного, ментального та емоційного балансу.
jobs.description:
Про нас:

BetterMe — глобальна wellness-екосистема, що створює продукти для фізичного, ментального та емоційного балансу. Ми допомагаємо мільйонам людей ставати кращими — і зростаємо разом із ними.

Ми шукаємо Backend Engineer, який стане частиною команди Core та допоможе будувати стабільні, масштабовані бекенд-рішення для продукту з мільйонами користувачів. Роль поєднує розробку нових функцій, оптимізацію наявних сервісів і глибоку роботу з архітектурою системи.

Твої майбутні задачі:

  • Розробка нових бекенд-функціоналу з використанням Go як основної мови та частковою роботою з PHP codebase (~80/20).
  • Міграція бізнес-логіки з легасі PHP монолітів у Go сервіси.
  • Забезпечення стабільності, продуктивності та надійності систем у продакшн середовищі.
  • Участь у покращенні інфраструктурних процесів: CI/CD, observability, operational excellence.
  • Тісна співпраця з product-командою та стейкхолдерами для реалізації end-to-end рішень у домені.
  • Проведення code review з фокусом на best practices, code quality та maintainability.

Що для цього тобі знадобиться?

  • 5+ років досвіду в backend-розробці.
  • Комерційний досвід роботи з Golang.
  • Досвід роботи з PHP (бажано Symfony або Laravel).
  • Розуміння idiomatic Go patterns, best practices та підходів до структурування Go-застосунків.
  • Досвід роботи з реляційними базами даних - MySQL та/або PostgreSQL.
  • Досвід асинхронної взаємодії (RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, Amazon SQS або подібні).
  • Досвід роботи з кешуванням та in-memory сховищами (Redis / AWS ElastiCache).
  • Infrastructure exposure: Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, observability та/або досвід troubleshooting у production.
  • Досвід роботи з Linux та Docker.
  • Вміння писати й підтримувати unit тести, забезпечувати якість та надійність коду.
  • Навички розвʼязання проблем і здатність працювати зі складними системами або доменами.

Буде круто, якщо ти маєш:

  • Досвід міграції з PHP-моноліту до Go-сервісів.
  • Сильний досвід роботи з PHP 8+ (Symfony або Laravel).
  • Досвід роботи з розподіленими системами та високонавантаженими сервісами.
  • Досвід роботи з cloud- та container orchestration інструментами: AWS services, Kubernetes, Helm, service mesh technologies (Istio або подібні).
  • Практичний досвід роботи з мікросервісною архітектурою та REST APIs.
  • Знання architectural design principles: Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, DDD.
  • Сильні навички комунікації та командної взаємодії.

Що на тебе чекає в BetterMe:

Місія, що надихає. Кожен наш код, дизайн, ідея допомагають мільйонам людей ставати здоровішими і впевненішими.
Довіра без мікроменеджменту. Ти самостійно керуєш своїм часом і приймаєш рішення. Ми цінуємо результат, а не години онлайн.
Можливості росту. 90% наших лідів виросли всередині компанії. Є простір для ініціатив, нових обов’язків і кар’єрного апґрейду.
Гнучкий формат роботи. Обирай, що підходить саме тобі — офіс, remote або hybrid.
Wellness на практиці. Офлайн: тренування з професійними тренерами в корпоративному спортзалі, масаж, корпоративні обіди, спортивні і командні активності — усе, щоб перемикатись і заряджатись разом. Онлайн: регулярні онлайн-тренування, знижки від наших партнерів, безкоштовний доступ до наших продуктів.
Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар.
Відкрита комунікація. Прозорість між командами, чесний фідбек і підтримка ініціатив — наша звична практика.
Підтримуємо участь у спортивних івентах. Покриваємо стартові внески й мотивуємо команду виступати разом.
Сучасна техніка. Ми забезпечуємо нове обладнання й усе необхідне для продуктивної роботи.
Амбіційне середовище, яке отримує визнання. За останні два роки команда BetterMe зросла вдвічі та потрапила в ТОП-10 місць роботи за версією Forbes 2026.

jobs.description:
🚀 Tu souhaites devenir le prochain Customer Success Manager (ou Chargé(e) de relation client) d'une des meilleures start-ups? Nous te formons pendant 4 semaines et nous t'accompagnons dans ton recrutement avec un focus fit et rémunération ! 💼

💰 +90% des participants ont rejoint une entreprise un mois après la fin de la formation avec une rémunération moyenne de 38K € bruts annuels.

DESCRIPTIF

Ta future mission : Être garant de la satisfaction et de la fidélisation client.

Chaque jour pendant 1 mois, 💻 à distance, tu travailleras sur une problématique concrète liée à la relation client (onboarding, upsell, outils...etc) avec un expert du métier.

Après ces 4 semaines tu sauras gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vie des clients et tu rejoindras le top 10% des professionnels du secteur.

Une fois ton poste trouvé, ton quotidien sera :

1/ La formation et le suivi de tes clients

  • Ton rôle sera de t'assurer de la satisfaction de tes clients au quotidien.
  • Former et éduquer les clients sur le produit et répondre aux questions sur différents sujets.
  • Mettre à disposition des clients toutes les connaissances dont ils ont besoin (vidéos, articles, aide contextuelle...).

2/ La collaboration avec les équipes en interne

  • Tu seras la personne qui connaîtra le mieux tes clients et seras leur porte-parole parmi les différentes équipes de ton entreprise.
  • Tu seras force de proposition pour faire remonter les retours clients les plus récurrents et pertinents à l'équipe produit.
  • Tu travailleras avec des membres d'autres équipes pour trouver des solutions afin d'aider les clients avant même qu'ils rencontrent un problème.

PROFIL RECHERCHE

Nous ne cherchons pas de diplôme, mais des personnalités qui s'épanouiront dans le métier !

  • Tu aimes le contact avec les autres ? 🤝
  • Qualités rédactionnelles, tu sais manier les mots comme personne ? ✍️
  • Autonome, tu sais mettre les mains dans le cambouis pour trouver des solutions par toi-même ? 🛠️
  • Adaptabilité, tes journées ne seront jamais les mêmes et tu aimes les nouveaux défis ! 🔄
  • Tu sais prendre des initiatives ? On dit de toi que tu es organisé(e) et rigoureux/se.

PROCESSUS

Si ton profil est sélectionné, nous t'appellerons pour en découvrir plus sur toi et ton projet de formation.

Nous passons 4 semaines ensemble à te former avec des experts du Customer Success Management.

Nous te coachons pendant l'ensemble des phases du processus de recrutement pour que rien ne soit laissé au hasard et t'aidons à trouver l'opportunité qui TE correspond !

Tu rejoins ton entreprise, prêt(e) à t'épanouir dans ta nouvelle carrière ! 🚀

jobs.title: Senior Technical Support Specialist (FinTech / Open Banking)
jobs.excerpt: Social Discovery Group (SDG) is one of the world's largest groups of social discovery companies, uniting millions of users on dozens of products.
jobs.description:
Social Discovery Group (SDG) is one of the world's largest groups of social discovery companies, uniting millions of users on dozens of products. SDG solves the problem of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection - transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. SDG products redefine the way people interact and connect with each other.

Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures in different parts of the world. This includes globally recognized brands such as DateMyAge, Dating.com, EuroDate, Dil Mil and Cupid Media. SDG has a presence in more than 150 countries.

We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals specializing in the creation and development of globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of 1000+ professionals and digital nomads works all over the world. Our teams of digital nomads work remotely from Cyprus, Malta, the USA, Armenia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Montenegro, Poland, Latvia, Serbia, Spain, Portugal, UAE, Israel, Turkey, Thailand, Indonesia, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia and many other locations.

We’re proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025).

We are looking for a Senior Technical Support Specialist to join Noda — a fast-growing open banking payment platform operating across the European market.

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving complex technical issues, working closely with merchants and internal engineering teams, and taking ownership during critical situations. You will become a key expert inside the support team, help scale internal processes, and directly influence the quality and stability of our payment operations.

Your main tasks will be:

  • Support merchants during integration with Noda’s payment solutions;
  • Investigate complex technical and payment-related issues using logs, monitoring tools, and internal systems;
  • Diagnose incidents, identify root causes, and coordinate resolutions with internal teams;
  • Ensure smooth and stable operation of payment flows and integrations;
  • Collaborate closely with Payments, Automation, SRE, Account Management, and Product teams;
  • Improve and maintain technical documentation, integration guides, and internal knowledge base;
  • Participate in integration testing and quality control processes;
  • Mentor junior team members and help improve support standards across the team.

We expect from you:

  • 4+ years of experience in Technical Support, Integration Support, or Payment Support roles;
  • Experience working with FinTech, payment systems, PSPs, or open banking products;
  • Strong understanding of HTTP, APIs, client-server architecture, and payment flows;
  • Hands-on experience with logs and monitoring tools (Kibana or similar);
  • Understanding of incident management processes, SLA/SLO principles, and production support environments;
  • Experience working with SQL/NoSQL databases;
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills;
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to build trusted relationships with merchants and internal stakeholders;
  • Experience mentoring or supporting junior team members;
  • Fluent Russian and English level B2 or higher.

What do we offer:

  • REMOTE OPPORTUNITY to work full-time;
  • Vacation 28 calendar days per year;
  • 7 wellness days per year (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave;
  • Bonuses up to $5000 for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company;
  • 50% payment for professional training, international conferences, and meetings;
  • Corporate discount for English lessons;
  • ​Health benefits. According to the paychecks, if you are not eligible for corporate medical insurance, the company will compensate you with up to $ 1,000 gross per year per employee. This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor’s fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children);
  • ​Workplace organization. The company provides all employees with an equipped workplace and all the necessary equipment (table, armchair, wifi, etc.) in our offices or co-working locations. In the other locations, the company provides reimbursement of workplace costs up to $ 1000 gross once every 3 years, according to the paychecks. This money can be spent on the rent of the co-working room, on equipping the working place at home (desk, chair, Internet, etc.) during those 3 years;
  • Internal gamified gratitude system: receive bonuses from colleagues and exchange them for our merchandise, team building activities, massage certificates, etc.

Sounds good? Join us now!

jobs.description:
Job Title: Full-Stack Android Developer - React Native (Pooling)Company: White Cloak Technologies Inc.
Employment Type: Project-based (for future opportunities)
Location: Philippines (Hybrid / Remote, depending on client requirement)

About White Cloak Technologies Inc.White Cloak Technologies Inc. is a technology consulting and professional services company delivering digital solutions across software engineering, cloud, and data. We work with enterprise and high-growth clients to build scalable, high-quality applications using modern technologies.

As part of our talent pooling, we are continuously looking for Software Engineers - Android who are open to future project-based or full-time opportunities.

Role OverviewThis Android Developer is a full-stack engineer with deep Android expertise who builds cross-platform mobile applications using React Native while maintaining strong native Android skills for platform-specific optimizations. Beyond mobile, this role contributes to backend services(NestJS/Python) that power mobile features and builds web features when capacity allows.

The individual owns the Android experience end-to-end: from API integration to Google Play deployment, performance optimization, and platform-specific native module development.

Key Responsibilities:

Android & React Native Development (Primary Focus)

  • Build and maintain the Android mobile application using React Native with TypeScript.
  • Develop platform-specific native modules (Java/Kotlin) when React Native abstractions are insufficient.
  • Optimize Android performance – memory management, battery usage, app startup time, render performance.
  • Manage Google Play Store deployment pipeline – builds, signing, staged rollouts, release management.
  • Implement Android-specific features: deep linking, push notifications, background services, permissions.
  • Debug Android-specific issues using Android Studio, ADB, Flipper, and React Native debugging tools.
  • Ensure consistent UX between Android and iOS implementations.

Full-Stack Backend Contributions

  • Build and maintain NestJS API endpoints that power mobile features – push notification services, device management, sync APIs.
  • Contribute to Python-based backend services for data processing, file handling, and mobile-specific workflows.
  • Design mobile-optimized API responses – pagination, data compression, offline-first sync patterns.
  • Write database queries and manage mobile-related data schemas in PostgreSQL and MongoDB.

Web Frontend Contributions

  • Contribute to React/TypeScript web features when sprint capacity allows.
  • Share components and business logic between React Native mobile and React web where applicable.
  • Participate in code reviews across mobile, backend, and web PRs.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate development and solve complex platform issues.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of mobile development with at least 2 years React Native + Android experience.
  • Strong Android fundamentals – Activity lifecycle, native modules, platform APIs, performance profiling.
  • React Native expertise – navigation, state management, native bridge, Expo ecosystem.
  • TypeScript proficiency – type-safe mobile development, shared type definitions.
  • NestJS / Node.js competency – can build and maintain backend APIs for mobile features.
  • Python basics – scripting, data processing, simple API development.
  • Google Play deployment – end-to-end app submission, staged rollouts, crash reporting.
  • Database skills – PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and mobile local storage (SQLite/AsyncStorage).
  • AI tool proficiency – uses AI coding assistants; understands LLM API basics.
  • Good English communication – clear documentation and async collaboration.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with iOS development or Swift for cross-platform debugging.
  • Knowledge of on-device ML frameworks (TensorFlow Lite, ONNX).
  • Experience with OTA update systems (CodePush, Expo Updates).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile (Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions).

This is a talent pooling role. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted as project requirements arise.

jobs.excerpt: Account Director, GermanyLocation: Remote, Germany Employment Type: Full-Time Gross Annual Base Salary: EUR €110,000 - €125,000 Additional variable compensation and benefits may apply.
jobs.description:
Account Director, Germany

Location: Remote, Germany

Employment Type: Full-Time

Gross Annual Base Salary: EUR €110,000 - €125,000

Additional variable compensation and benefits may apply. Total compensation is based on experience, skills, and location using objective, job-related criteria.

Summary

The Account Director is responsible for the sale of OneStream SaaS solutions within a specified territory.
OneStream is looking for an experienced, proactive sales professional to manage and grow existing customer relationships through subscription renewals and expansion, uplifts and cross-selling of additional solutions. The role will be responsible for strategic planning and account management across a designated sales territory and will be expected to take full ownership within this territory. Account Directors are to successfully retain and grow the existing solution footprint and meet and ideally exceed assigned quota. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of SaaS sales and a proven track record in sales within an existing account base.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • Opportunity Identification: Proactively identify new sales opportunities within the existing customer base by understanding their evolving needs and challenges and OneStream’s value proposition.
  • Upselling and Cross-Selling: Introduce additional products or services that meet the evolving needs of our customers, driving upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Internal Reporting: CRM knowledge transfer, sales pipeline management, and proposal preparation.
  • Self-Sourced Pipeline: Grow pipeline via direct efforts / prospecting, as well as via business partners such as Customer Success, Business Development, Marketing, and Alliances.
  • Be Business Partner to your Customers: Provide proactive and consultative guidance that will add value to their business objectives, ensuring high retention and net revenue growth for OneStream. This is executed by developing a thorough understanding of your customers' position in the market, their product/service, points of difference and competitive landscape.
  • Position OneStream: Articulately and effectively convey the OneStream value proposition via written, virtual and in-person presentations, by leveraging custom business cases, marketing assets and customer success stories.
  • Enable your Customer Champions: Prepare joint business cases that align prospects and customers’ business objectives with OneStream’s solutions and value proposition and leverage them in sales cycles to establish and build alignment to support revenue generation. Achieve sales targets.
  • Develop and execute business plans to achieve sales targets.
  • Accurately track and forecast sales opportunities.
  • Grow pipeline via direct efforts / prospecting, as well as via business partners such as Customer Success, Business Development, Marketing, and Alliances.
  • Ensure timely and accurate knowledge transfer across internal teams, such as Business Development, Pre-Sales, Alliances, and Customer Success, as well as to external collaborators such as Customers, Prospects, and Alliance Partners.
  • Assess prospects and customers’ needs for OneStream offerings via research, discovery sessions and solution demonstrations.
  • Prepare joint business cases that align prospects and customers’ business objectives with OneStream’s solutions and value proposition and leverage them in sales cycles to establish and build alignment to support revenue generation.
  • Prepare proposals and SaaS agreements to prospects and customers to drive sales.
  • Identify opportunities for OneStream use case expansion within customer accounts to drive additional revenue.
  • Develop comprehensive proposals in response to client and prospect requests.
  • Actively role model sales professionalism, may engage as a coach and mentor across the Sales teams.

Required Education & Experience

  • Minimum 5-10 years’ experience as a sales manager, sales representative or a related occupation specifically in B2B selling across the Enterprise accounts.
  • Proven track record in hitting quota and retention targets.
  • Organized, detail-oriented with the ability to prioritize and respond quickly.
  • Negotiation skills as it relates to renewals, upsell, cross-selling and additional solution add-ons.
  • Highly proficient in MS Office Suite, and CRM systems.
  • Experience working in a consultative capacity with C-level customers on complex SaaS solutions.
  • Extensive customer service experience in assessing and evaluating customer needs and satisfaction and meeting specified standards with respect to products and services.
  • Exceptional oral and written comprehension, communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience demonstrating, promoting, and selling products/services.
  • Knowledge and experience with marketing/sales strategy and tactics.
  • Knowledge of administration, business, and management principles.
  • Extensive experience working in a team environment.
  • Track record of exceeding revenue goals.
  • Fluent in German and English a must.

Preferred Education & Experience

  • University Degree or College Diploma in Sales, Business Administration, Marketing or a related field.
  • Prior sales experience in the software industry, especially within the CPM/EPM industry.
  • Experience with Salesforce is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Accounting, Finance and Corporate Performance Management.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Professional.
  • Strategic.
  • Capable of building rapport with C-level executives and customers.
  • Highly organized.
  • Tech-savvy.
  • Ability to understand and react to customer needs.
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Flexible and adaptable.
  • Goal driven.

Who We Are

OneStream is how today’s Finance teams can go beyond just reporting on the past and Take Finance Further™ by steering the business to the future. It’s the only enterprise finance platform that unifies financial and operational data, embeds AI for better decisions and productivity, and empowers the CFO to become a critical driver of business strategy and execution.  Our vision is to be the operating system for modern finance, digitizing core financial functions and empowering the CFO to become a critical driver of business strategy. To learn more visit www.onestream.com.

Why Join The OneStream Team

  • Transparency around corporate structure, salary, and benefits.
  • Core value of customer success.
  • Variety of project work (not industry specific).
  • Strong culture and camaraderie.
  • Multiple training opportunities.

All candidates must be legally authorized to work for any company in the country where this position is located without sponsorship.

OneStream Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
